doc.p:
nanu1 anādyanantarūpa iti viśeṣaṇamātmanaḥ kathaṃ yoyujyate | kāyā-
kārapariṇatiyogyebhyo bhūtebhyaścaitanyaṃ jāyate | jalabudbudavadanityā jīvā
ityabhidhānāt | na keṣāmapi mate jīvasyānādyanantatvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ jāgha-
ṭyate | na tāvat pratyakṣaṃ tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ, tasya saṃbaddhavartamānārthaviṣaya-
tvena anādyanantatvagrahaṇāyogāt | nānumānamapi tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ,
tathāvidhānumānābhāvāt | athāstyanumānaṃ2 tadgrāhakaṃ jīvaḥ sarvadāsti
sadakāraṇatvāt3 pṛthvīvaditi4 cenna | hetorviśeṣyāsiddhatvāt5 | katha-
miti cet--kāyākārapariṇatabhūtacatuṣṭayāccaitanyotpatteścārvākairaṅgīkṛtatvāt |
cārvākaḥ |
jīvāstisādhakavādī |
saṃśca akāraṇaśca tasya bhāvaḥ |
cārvākamate pṛthvī sarvadāsti |
akāraṇatvāt iti viśeṣyaḥ saditi viśeṣaṇam |
saditi viśeṣaṇamapi sarvadā sattvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ kadācit sattvaṃ vā vivakṣi-
tam | prathamapakṣe asiddhatvaṃ1 sarvadā sattvasya sādhyasamatvāt | dvitīyapakṣe-
viruddhatvaṃ kadācit sattvasya sarvadāstitvaviparītaprasādhakatvāt | atha2
jīvaḥ sarvadāsti sadakāryatvāt pṛthvīvaditi cenna3 | asyāpi taddoṣeṇaiva4
duṣṭatvāt | atha jīvaḥ sarvadāsti vibhutvāt ākāśavaditi cet na | hetoḥ
prativādyasiddhatvāt5 | atha jīvaḥ sarvadāsti amūrtatvāt ākāśavaditi
cet na | hetoḥ kriyābhirvyabhicārāt6 | nanu 7tatparihārārthamamūrtadravyatvā-
dityucyate, tarhi cārvākamate jīvasya pṛthagdravyatvābhāvāt prativādyasiddho
hetvābhāsaḥ | atha jīvaḥ sarvadāsti niravayavatvāt paramāṇuvaditi cenna |
pūrvavat kriyābhirvyabhicārāt | tatparihārārthaṃ niravayavadravyatvādityukte
dravyatvasya pūrvavadasiddhatvācca | atha jīvaḥ sarvadāsti cetanatvāt,
viśeṣaṇasya asiddhatvaṃ hetoḥ |
jīvāstitvavādī |
cārvākaḥ |
pūrvotta-
hetudoṣeṇa?? |
jīvo vibhurvartate iti prativādinā nāṅgīkriyate ataḥ prativādyasiddhaḥ |
kriyā sarvadā nāsti amūrtatvāt iti vyabhicāraḥ, kriyā amūrtāsti paraṃtu sarvadā
nāsti |
kriyā tu amūrtā vartate paraṃtu dravyaṃ na |
yatsarvadā nāsti taccetanaṃ na bhavati yathā kharaviṣāṇamiti cenna | hetorana-
dhyavasitatvāt | kathamiti cet sapakṣe1 asattvādaniścitavyāptikatve pakṣe
eva vartamānatvāt dṛṣṭāntasyāpyāśrayahīnatvācca | atha ādyaṃ caitanyaṃ3
caitanyapūrvakaṃ cidvivartatvāt madhyacidvivartavaditi anāditvasiddhiriti
cenna | hetorakiṃcitkaratvāt | tatkathamiti cet ‘siddhe pratyakṣādibādhite
ca sādhye heturakiṃcitkaraḥ’ [parīkṣāmukha 3-35] iti jainairabhihitatvāt,
atra tvādyacaitanyasya mātāpitṛcaitanyapūrvakatvena siddhatvāt | nanu ādyaṃ
caitanyaṃ caitanyopādānakāraṇakaṃ4 cidvivartatvāt madhyacidvivarta-
vaditi anāditvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvāt |
kuta iti cet madhyacidvivartasya kāyopādānakāraṇakatvena caitanyopādāna-
kāraṇakatvābhāvāt | atha antyaṃ caitanyam5 uttaracaitanyopādānakāraṇaṃ
vidvivartatvāt madhyacidvivartavat ityanantatvasiddhiriti cenna |
sarvadāstītyādau sapakṣe ākāśādau |
yathā kharaviṣāṇamiti dṛṣṭāntasya |
mātṛgarbhastham |
caitanyameva upādānakāraṇaṃ yasya |
maraṇasamayam |
atrāpi dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatvāt1 | tasmānnānumānaṃ jīvasyānādya-
nantatvamāvedayati |

āgamo'pi na tat pratipādayituṃ samarthaḥ tatra2 prāmāṇyābhāvāt |
āgamo hyāptavacanādiḥ3 | āpto hyavañcako'bhijñaḥ so'pi kiṃcijjñatvā-
llaukikārthānevānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cakṣurādibhirupalabhya pratipādayati, na
tu jīvasyānādyanantatvādikam | tatparijñāne kiṃcijjñasya sāmarthyābhāvāt |

atha sarvajña eva jīvasyānādyanantatvaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratipradya kiṃcijjñānāṃ
pratipādayatīti cenna | sarvajñāvedakapramāṇābhāvāt | na tāvadāgamastadā-
vedakaḥ sarvajñāsiddhāvāgamasyāprāmāṇyāt | apramāṇādāgamāt sarvajñasiddhe-
rayogācca | nāpi pratyakṣaṃ sarvajñāvedakaṃ pramāṇam atredānīṃ pratyakṣeṇa sarvajña-
syānupalabdheḥ | nānumānamapi tadāvedakaṃ, sarvajñāvinābhāviliṅgābhāvāt |
athāstyanumānaṃ tadāvedakaṃ-kaścit puruṣaḥ sakalapadārthasākṣātkārī, tad-
grahaṇasvabhāvatve sati prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayatvāt4 yad yadgrahaṇasvabhāvatve
sati prakṣīṇapratibandhakapratyayaṃ tat tat sakalapadārthasākṣātkāri, yathā
apagatatimiraṃ locanaṃ rūpasākṣātkāri, tathā cāyaṃ kaścit puruṣaḥ, tasmāt
kutaḥ kāyopādānakāraṇatvenotpannatvāt |
jīvasya anādyanantatvasādhane |
ādiśabdena aṅūgulyādiparigrahaḥ |
kāraṇatvāt jñānatvāt ca |
sakalapadārthasākṣātkārīti cenna | dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyasādhanobhayavikala-
tvāt | kathamiti cet sakalapadārthasākṣātkāritvasādhyasya sakalapadārtha-
grahaṇasvabhāve sati prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayatvasādhanasya ca apagatatimira-
locane abhāvāt | atha sūkṣmāntaritadūrārthāḥ kasyacit pratyakṣāḥ, anumeya-
tvāt, pāvakavaditi cenna | anumeyatvasya hetoranumityā vyāptatvena1 pratyakṣā-
vinābhāvābhāvāt | kutaḥ 2adṛṣṭānumānasāmānyatodṛṣṭānumānaviṣayeṣu3
anumeyatvasadbhāve'pyubhayavādiprasiddhapratyakṣābhāvāt | asiddhatvācca | tathā
hi-pakṣīkṛteṣu deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭārtheṣu anumeyatvāditi hetorabhāvāt |
ata eva pratyakṣatvaṃ4 na sādhayati | atha kasyacit pratyakṣāste prameyatvāt
karatalavadityucyate | tarhi prameyatvasyāpi pramayā vyāptatvena pratyakṣāvinā-
bhāvābhāvāt na tataḥ pratyakṣatvasiddhiḥ5 | atha sarvajño dharmī astīti
agnyādijñānamanumitiḥ, anumitistu parokṣā |
adṛṣṭādayaḥ kasyacit
pratyakṣāḥ anumeyatvāt iti adṛṣṭānumānam |
yacca sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ tadevaṃ gatipūrvikā |
puṃsi deśāntaraprāptiḥ yathā sūrye gatistathā || ityādi |
anumeyatvaṃ hetuḥ kasyacit
pratyakṣatvam iti na sādhayati |
kasyacit pratyakṣā iti siddhiṃrna |
sādhyate asaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇatvāt sukhādivaditi cet na | hetorāśrayā-
siddhatvāt | anekabādhakapramāṇasaṃbhavena asaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇasya
svarūpāsiddhatvācca | nanu1 tanukaraṇabhuvanādikaṃ buddhimadhetukaṃ2 kāryatvāt
paṭādivadityetadanumānaṃ sarvajñāvedakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | hetorbhāgāsiddha-
tvāt | kuta iti cet bhavadabhimatasya kāryatvasya parvatādiṣvapravartanāt3
tasmāt sarvajño nāsti, anupalabdheḥ kharaviṣāṇavat | atha4 atredānīmasma-
dādibhiranupalambhe'pi deśāntare kālāntare puruṣāntarairupalabhyata iti cenna |
anumānavirodhāt | tathā hi | vīto5 deśaḥ sarvajñarahitaḥ deśatvādetad-
deśavat | vītaḥ6 kālaḥ sarvajñarahitaḥ kālatvāt idānīṃtanakālavat |
naiyāyikaḥ |
sarvajñahetukam |
parvatāstu sadā vartante eva, na kāryarūpāḥ,
ataḥ kāryatvādayaṃ hetuḥ parvateṣu na pravartate |
naiyāyikaḥ |
vivādāpannaḥ |
vi
viśeṣam itaḥ prāptaḥ vītaḥ |
vītaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvajñaṃ na paśyati puruṣatvāt asmadādivaditi | sarvajñābhāvāt
tatpraṇītāgamābhāvaḥ | atha1 sarvajñapraṇītāgamābhāve'pi apauruṣeyāgamasad-
bhāvāt sa eva jīvasyānādyanantatvamāvedayatīti cenna | padasaṃdarbharūpatvena
āgamasyāpauruṣeyatvāyogātū | tathā hi | vedavākyāni pauruṣeyāṇi vākya-
tvāt kādambarīvākyavat | evamāgamasya prāmāṇyābhāvāt kathaṃ tena
jīvasyānādyanantatvādikaṃ vevidyase tvam | tasmāt tadgrāhakapramāṇābhāvāt
sādisanidhana eva jīvo ajāghaṭiṣṭa2 |

tathā ca prayogāḥ3 | jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ dravyatve sati pratyakṣatvāt |
jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ viśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt4, dravyatvāvāntarasāmānya-
vattvāt5, kriyāvattvācca, paṭavaditi ca | evaṃ ca
dehātmikā dehakāryā dehasya ca guṇo matiḥ |
matatrayamihāśritya jīvābhāvo'bhidhīyate || (pramāṇavārtikabhāṣya pṛ. 53)
mīmāṃsakaḥ |
mṛśaṃ saṃghaṭate sma |
anumāna |
buddhisukhaduḥkhādi-
viśeṣaguṇāḥ |
dravyatvaṃ ca tadavāntarasāmānyaṃ |
ityayamapyupapanna eva | atrāpi prayogasadbhāvāt | dehātmako jīvaḥ
dehādanyatrānupalabdheḥ śirādivaditi puraṃdaraḥ1 | dehakāryo2 jīvaḥ dehā-
nvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt ucchvāsavadityudbhaṭaḥ | dehaguṇo jīvaḥ
dehāśritatvāt dehasya rūpādivadityaviddhakarṇaḥ | tasmāt pṛthivyaptejo-
vāyuriti catvāryeva tattvāni | kāyākārapariṇatebhyastebhya3ścaitanyaṃ4 piṣṭo-
dakaguḍadhātukīsaṃyogānmadaśaktivat | tacca garbhādimaraṇaparyantaṃ jīvādi-
vyapadeśabhāk pravartate | garbhāt pūrvakāle maraṇāduttarakāle ca tasyābhāvāt
pūrvaśarīrakṛtādṛṣṭaṃ tatphalabhogaśca yataḥ saṃpadyate5 | atha6 pūrvajanmakṛtādṛṣṭā-
bhāve kecit śrīmantaḥ kecid daridrāḥ kecit stutyāḥ kecinnindyāḥ kecit
pūjyāḥ kecidapūjyāḥ ityādivicitravyavasthā kathaṃ bobhavītīti cenna |
adṛṣṭarahiteṣu śilādiṣu7 tādṛgvicitravyavasthopalambhāt | atha tatrāpi
tadāśrita8jīvādṛṣṭāt śilādīnāṃ pūjādikamiti cenna | anyakṛtādṛṣṭenā-
nyasya phalabhoge kṛtanāśākṛtābhyāgamadoṣaprasaṃgāt | apasiddhāntāpātaśca |
purandaraḥ udbhaṭaḥ aviddhakarṇaḥ iti cārvākabhedāḥ |
dehastu kāraṇaṃ jīvaḥ
kāryarūpaḥ |
pṛthivyādibhyaścaturbhyaḥ |
upajāyate |
na kuto'pi |
mīmāṃsakaḥ |
pratimāṣu |
śilāśrita |
‘kartā yaḥ karmaṇāṃ bhoktā tatphalānāṃ sa eva hi |’ (svarūpasaṃbodhana śloº 10)
ityabhidhānāt | tasmāt stutipūjādayo nādṛṣṭaprabhavāḥ stutipūjā-
ditvāt śilādīnāṃ stutipūjādivat1 | vītaṃ citraṃ2 nādṛṣṭaprabhavaṃ vicitra-
tvāt pāṣāṇādivaicitryavat3 | iti laukāyata4 matasiddhiḥ || [4. uttarapakṣe jīvānityatāniṣedhaḥ |]
atra pratividhīyate | ye tāvaduktā jīvasya kādācitkatve prayogāste
tāvad vicāryante | tatra pratyakṣaikapramāṇavādinaścārvāṃkasyānumānaprāmāṇyā-
yathā śilādīnāṃ stutipūjādikaṃ adṛṣṭaprabhavaṃ na |
kecit sukhinaḥ kecit
duḥkhinaḥ iti |
yathā pāṣāṇādivaicitryaṃ adṛṣṭaprabhavaṃ na tathā anyatrāpi vaicitryam
adṛṣṭaprabhavaṃ na |
cārvākamata |
bhāvāt kathaṃ tena jīvasya kādācitkatvaṃ prasādhyate | atha1 anumānasya
saṃvṛtyā2 prāmāṇyamiṣyata iti cet tathāpi bhavaduktānumānānāmanekadoṣa-
duṣṭatvānna sveṣṭasiddhiḥ | tathā hi | jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ dravyatve sati
pratyakṣatyāt paṭavadityatra pratyakṣatvaṃ nāma3 bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvaṃ svasaṃvedana-
pratyakṣatvaṃ mānasapratyakṣatvaṃ vā | prathamapakṣe svarūpasiddho hetuḥ, jīvasya
bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvābhāvāt | dvitīyapakṣe vādyasiddho hetvābhāsaḥ cārvāka-
mate jīvasya bhūtajanyatvena paṭādivat svasaṃvedanapratyakṣābhāvāt, bhāve4 vā
paṭādau svasaṃvedanapratyakṣatvābhāvāt sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tṛtīyapakṣe'pi
sādhanaśūnyaṃ nidarśanaṃ, paṭādidṛṣṭānte mānasapratyakṣatvābhāvāt | dravyatve
satīti viśeṣaṇamapi vādyasiddhaṃ, jīvasya svayaṃ pṛthag dravyatvānaṅgīkārāt |
aṅgīkāre vā nityaṃ caitanyam advyaṇukātīndriyadravyatvāt5 paramāṇuvaditi
nityatvasiddherviruddhaṃ viśeṣaṇam | bhūbhūdharādihetorvyabhicāraśca, tatra dravyatve
sati pratyakṣatvahetoḥ sadbhāve'pi kādācitkatvasādhyābhāvāt6 | yadapyanyadanu-
cārvākaḥ |
lokavyavahāreṇa |
bho cārvāka |
jīvasya svasaṃvedana-
pratyakṣatvabhāve |
advyaṇukaṃ ca tat atīṃdriyadravyaṃ ca |
parvatāstu kādācitkā-
na bhavanti |
mānaṃ vyarīracat, jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ viśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt1 paṭādi-
vaditi, tadapyasat | hetorvādyasiddhatvāt | kuta iti cet cārvākamate
caitanyasya viśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvābhāvāt | bhāve vā nityaṃ caitanyaṃ dvyaṇukā-
nyātīndriyatve sati viśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt paramāṇuvaditi viparīta-
prasādhakatvād viruddhaḥ | paramāṇubhirvyabhicāraśca | kutaḥ paramāṇuṣu rūpādi-
viśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvasadbhāve'pi kādācitkatvābhāvāt | atha vyabhicāra-
parihārārthaṃ paramāṇvanyatve2 satīti viśeṣaṇamupādīyata iti cenna | cārvāka-
mate caitanyasya paramāṇvanyatvāsiddheḥ3 | kutaḥ tasya bhūtātmakatvāṅgīkārāt |
tanmate pṛthivyaptejovāyuparamāṇūnāmeva bhūtaśabdavācyatvamitarasya4 bhūta-
kāryatvaṃ, kāryasya kāraṇātmakatvamiti pratipādanāt | tasya caitanyasya
pṛthag dravyatvāṅgīkāre nityaṃ caitanyam adbyaṇukātīndriyadravyatvāt paramāṇu-
vaditi viparītasādhanād viruddho hetuḥ syāt | yadapyanyadanumānaṃ nyarūru-
pat-jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ dravyatvāvāntarasāmānyavattvāt ghaṭādivaditi
jñānādiguṇaḥ |
paramāṇurahitatve sati |
caitanyaṃ paramāṇubhūtameva nānyat
iti cārvākamatam |
caitanyasya |
tadapyacāru, hetoḥ paramāṇu1bhirvyabhicārāt | atha anaṇutve sati dravyatvā-
vāntarasāmānyavattvādityucyate tathāpi hetoḥ parvatairanekāntaḥ | kathaṃ
parvateṣu anaṇutve sati dravyatvāvāntarasāmānyavattvasya sadbhāve'pi kādā-
citkatvābhāvāt | yadapyanyadanumānaṃ pratyapīpadat-jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ kriyā-
vattvāt ghaṭādivaditi tadapyanucitam | paramāṇuṣu kriyāvattvasadbhāve'pi
kādācitkatvābhābāt | atha2 anaṇutve sati kriyāvattvāditi hetuḥ
sopyasādhuḥ | jyotirgaṇeṣu anaṇutve sati kriyāvattvasadbhāve'pi kādācitka-
tvābhāvena tairanekāntāt | atha teṣām udayāstasadbhāvāt kādācitka-
tvamastīti cenna | dhruvatārādīnāmudayāstarahitānāṃ bahūnāmapyupalambhāt |
atha teṣāmapyahanyadarśanād rātrau darśanāt kādācitkatvamiti cet tarhi
bhbhūdharādīnāmapi3 tathā syādityatiprasajyate | etena yadapyanyadavādīt
jīvaḥ kādācitkaḥ viśiṣṭākāradhāritvāt avāntaraparimāṇādhāratvāt
paṭādivaditi tannirastam | parvatādibhi4rhetoranekāntasadbhāvāt |
paramāṇuṣu dravyatvāvāntarasāmānyavattve'pi kādācitkatvābhāvāt |
bho cārvāka
atha evam |
bhūdharādīnām ahani darśanaṃ rātrau adarśanaṃ vartate paraṃtu na te kādācitkāḥ |
parvatādiṣu viśiṣṭākāradhāritvasadbhāve'pi kādācitkatvābhāvāt |
[5. jīvanityatā-samarthanam |]
tasmādanādyananto jīvaḥ advyaṇukatve sati atīndriyadravyatvāt
niravayavadravyatvācca paramāṇuvat | atha jīvasya niravayavatvamasiddhamiti
cenna | jīvo niravayavaḥ advyaṇukatve bāhyendriyagrahaṇāyogyatvāt paramāṇuva-
diti niravayatvasiddheḥ | tarhi dravyatvamasiddhamiti cenna | jīvo dravyaṃ guṇā-
dhāratvāt paramāṇuvaditi dravyatvasiddheḥ | atha guṇādhāratvamapyasiddhamiti
cenna | tatsādhakapramāṇasadbhāvāt | tathāhi śabdādijñānaṃ kvacidāśritaṃ
guṇatvāt rūpādivat | atha jñānasya guṇatvamasiddhamiti cenna | jñānaṃ guṇaḥ
kriyānyatve1 sati nirguṇatvāt2 avayavikriyānyatve sati upādānāśrita-
tvāt rūpādivaditi guṇatvasiddheḥ | atha tathāpi śabdādijñānasya śarīrā-
3śritatvāṅgīkāreṇa siddhasādhyatvād guṇatvāditi hetorakiṃcitkaratvamiti
cenna | tasya tadāśritatve4 bādhakasadbhāvāt | śarīraṃ na jñānādiguṇāśrayaṃ5
kriyārahitatve sati |
kriyāyāṃ nirguṇatvamasti tarhi kiṃ kriyā guṇaḥ ata

atha vedāḥ pramāṇamapauruṣeyatvāt saṃpratipannaliṃgādivaditi prāmāṇyaṃ
vedānāmiti cenna | vedānāṃ pauruṣeyatvenāpauruṣeyatvāsiddheḥ | tathā hi veda-

vedavākyāni pauruṣeyāṇi vākyatvāt atra vākyatvāt hetunā pauruṣeyatve sādhye
smaryamāṇakartṛtvam upādhiḥ |
katva bhāvāt1 nāstītyanupādhitvamiti | tasya sādhyavyāpakatvābhāvaḥ katha-
miti cet,
vyāvartakaṃ hi yad yasya svavyāvṛttivaśādiha2 |

iti vyāpyavyāpakayorlakṣaṇam | tathā ca purataḥ kriyamāṇakāryeṣu smaryamāṇa-

jñāyamānakartṛtvamupādhiriti cet tarhi jñāyamānasādhyatva3mupādhirityuktaṃ

pauruṣeyatvamasti smaryamāṇakartṛvaṃ nāsti |

ātmano bhoktṛtvābhāvādayamapyasiddho heturiti cenna | iṣṭāniṣṭaviṣayāṇā-
manubhavena svātmani vartamānasukhaduḥkhasākṣātkārāt sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyaha-
mityātmano bhoktṛtvapratīteḥ | tathā ātmā icchāprayatnavān kartṛtvāt
vyatireke paṭādivaditi3 ca | atha ātmanaḥ kartṛtvābhāvādayamapyasiddha iti
cenna | ghaṭamahaṃ cikorṣāmi paṭamahaṃ karomīti kartṛtvasya pratītisiddhatvāt |
tathā ātmā saṃskāravān smārakatvāt vyatireke paṭādivaditi4ca | atha
ātmanaḥ smārakatvābhāvādasiddho heturiti cenna | mama vittaṃ tatra nikṣiptaṃ
tasmai dattamiti vā smṛtvā punargrahaṇenātmanaḥ smārakatvapratīteḥ | tasmādā-
tmanaḥ jñātṛtvabhoktṛtvakartṛtvasmārakatvasadbhāvāt tasya buddhyādiviśeṣa-
guṇavattvasiddhiḥ | nanu antaḥkaraṇasyaiva jñātṛtvabhoktṛtvakartṛtvasmārakatva-
sadbhāvāt tasyaiva jñānādiguṇavattvaṃ nātmana iti cenna | antaḥkaraṇasya
tadasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | antaḥkaraṇaṃ na jñātṛ jaḍatvāt kāryatvāt cakṣurā
yaḥ jñānādiguṇavān na bhavati sa jñātā na bhavati yathā paṭaḥ |
yaḥ sukhādivān
na bhavati sa bhoktā na bhavati yathā paṭaḥ |
yaḥ icchāprayatnavān na bhavati sa kartā na
bhavati yathā paṭaḥ |
yaḥ saṃskāravān na bhavati sa smārako na bhavati yathā paṭaḥ |
divat | tathā antaḥkaraṇaṃ bhoktṛ na bhavati jaḍatvāt karaṇatvāt kāryatvāt
cakṣurādivat | tathā antaḥkaraṇaṃ kartṛ na bhavati jaḍatvāt karaṇatvāt
kāryatvāt cakṣurādivaditi | antaḥkaraṇasya jñātṛtvādyabhāvāt nāntaḥkaraṇaṃ
jñānādiguṇavat jaḍatvāt janyatvāt cakṣurādivaditi antaḥkaraṇasya
jñānādiguṇavattvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā cakṣurādikamapi na jñātṛtvādimat
jaḍatvāditi hetoḥ paṭādivaditi na dṛṣṭāntadoṣo'pīti | tasmājjīvasyaiva
jñātṛtvabhoktṛtvakartṛtvasadbhāvena jñānādiviśeṣaguṇavattvasiddhiriti |
tathā ātmā dravyatvavyatiriktāvāntarasattāsāmānyavān śarīrātma-
saṃyogasaṃyogitvāt śarīravadityātmano nānātvasiddhiḥ | nanu ātmanaḥ
saṃyogitvābhāvādasiddho hetvābhāsa iti cenna | ātmā saṃyogī dravyatvāt
paramāṇuvaditi ātmanaḥ saṃyogitvasiddheḥ | atha ātmano dravyatvābhāvādaya-
mapyasiddho heturiti cenna | ātmā dravyaṃ guṇādhāratvāt paramāṇuvaditi
dravyatvasiddhiḥ | nanu ‘sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca’ (śvetāśvatara 306-
11) iti śruterātmano nirguṇatvād guṇādhāratvamapyāsiddhamiti cenna |
ātmā jñānādiguṇavān jñātṛtvāt bhoktṛtvāt kartṛtvāt smārakatvāt
vyatireke paṭādivaditi ātmanaḥ prāgeva guṇādhāratvasamarthanāt |
[51. pratiśarīraṃ jīvapṛthaktvam |]
tathā kṣetrajñāḥ pratikṣetraṃ vibhinnā eva bhavanti ekasminneva kāle
ekasmin vastuni ayaṃ tattvavedī ayaṃ mithyājñānī ayaṃ rāgī ayaṃ virakta
ityādivyavasthānyathānupapatteḥ1 | nanu pratikṣetraṃ kṣetrajñābhedābhāve'pi2 antaḥ-
karaṇānāṃ pratikṣetraṃ bhedasadbhāvāt tadāśritatvenaiva vyavasthopapatterarthāpatte-
ranyathaivopaṣattiriti cenna | antaḥkaraṇaṃ dharmi tattvavedi mithyājñāni ityādi
vyavasthābhājanaṃ na bhavati jaḍatvāt janyatvāt karaṇatvāt avidyākārya-
tvāt cakṣurādivaditi antaḥkaraṇasya pramāṇādeva vyavasthābhājanatvānupa-
patterarthāpatternānyathopapattiḥ | nanu mama śrotraṃ samyag jānāti cakṣurviparītaṃ
jānātītyekātmādhiṣṭhiteṣūpādhiṣu3 ātmabhedābhāve'pi vyavasthopalabhyata
iti cenna | ekasmin vastunītyuktatvāt4 | kiṃ ca | śrotrādīnāṃ jñātṛtvā-
bhāvena samyagmithyājñānitvā5nupapatteḥ | atha śrotrādīnāṃ jñātṛtvābhāvaḥ
ekasmin ātmani ayaṃ tattvavedī ayaṃ mithyājñānīti vyavahārānupapatteḥ |
pratikṣetrātmabhinnatvamantareṇa |
cakṣuḥśrotrādiṣu |
sarvatra ekasmin ātmani sati ayaṃ
tattvavedītyādi uktatvāt |
samyagjñānitvaṃ mithyā jñānitvaṃ ca |
kathamiti cet śrotrādikaṃ jñātṛ na bhavati karaṇatvāt jaḍatvāt janyatvāt
avidyākāryatvāt indriyatvāt paṭādivaditi | tataścakṣurādīnāmantaḥ-
karaṇasya ca jñātṛtvādyabhāvena samyagmithyājñānitvādyanupapatteḥ | kṣetrajñe-
ṣveva samyagmithyājñānitvādivyavasthāsadbhāvāt tasyā1ścaikadaikasmin
vastunī2tyuktatvāt teṣāṃ3 pratikṣetraṃ bhedasiddhiḥ |
tathā vimatāni śarīrāṇi naikātmasaṃbandhāni kālāvyavadhāne'pya-
nyonyānanusaṃdhātṛtvāt4 vyatireke ekaśarīrendriyavaditi5 ca | tathā aneke
ātmānaḥ asmādādipratyakṣadravyatvāt śarīrādivat | pratyakṣadravyatvaṃ kutaḥ |
śravaṇamananādinātmasākṣātkārāṅgīkārāt | jñānāsamavāyyāśrayatvāt6
manovaditi ca | vivādāpanne ekakālīnasukhaduḥkhe vibhinnādhikaraṇe
ekakālonatve'pyekānusaṃdhānāgocaratvāt vyatireke ekakālīnaikaśarīra-
samyagjñānitvamithyājñānitvādivyavasthāyāḥ |
brahmalakṣaṇe |
kṣetrajñānāṃ |
ekasmin kāle bhinnasaṃdhātṛtvāt |
yat tu ekātmasambandhi bhavati tat tu
kālāvyavadhāne'pi ananusaṃdhātṛ na bhavati kiṃtu anusaṃdhātṛ bhavati yathā eka śarīreṃdriyaṃ
anusaṃdhātṛ |
jñānaṃ ca tat asamavāyikāraṇaṃ ca tasyāśrayatvāt |
sukhaduḥkhavaditi1 ca | tathā ayaṃ śarīrī anyaśarīrakṛtasukhaduḥkhāśrayo na
bhavati tatsākṣātkārarahitatvāt vyatireke taccharīrivaditi ca | tathā
vimatāni śarīrāṇi svasaṃkhyāsaṃkhyeyātmavanti2 asmadādipratyakṣayogya
jīvaśarīratvāt saṃpratipannaśarīravaditi | uktahetūnāṃ svarūpasya pramāṇa-
siddhatvānna svarūpāsiddhatvam | pakṣe sadbhāvānna vyadhikaraṇāsiddhatvam |
pakṣe sarvatra pravartamānatvāt na bhāgāsiddhatvam | pakṣasya sarvatra pramāṇapra-
siddhatvasamarthanānnāśrayāsiddhatvam | pakṣe hetorniścitatvānnājñātāsiddhatvaṃ
na saṃdigdhāsiddhatvaṃ ca | tattaddhetorviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ sāphalyasamarthanānna
viśeṣaṇāsiddhatvaṃ na viśeṣyāsiddhatvam | pakṣe teṣāṃ sadbhāvānna viśeṣya-
viśeṣaṇāsiddhatvam | sādhyaviparītaniścitāvinābhāvābhāvānna viruddhatvam |
thāsaṃbhavaṃ vipakṣād vyāvṛttatvānnānaikāntikatvam | yathāsaṃbhavaṃ sapakṣeya
sattvānnānadhyavasitatvam | pakṣe sādhyābhāvāvedakapratyakṣobhayavādisaṃprati-
ye vibhinnādhikaraṇe na bhavataḥ te ekakālīnatve'pi ekānusaṃdhānāgocare na bhavataḥ
yathā ekakālīnaśarīram |
śarīrasaṃkhyāpramāṇātmānaḥ yāvanti śarīrāṇi tākntaḥ ātmānaḥ
ityarthaḥ |
pannāgamābhāvānna kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvam | uktahetūnāṃ vipakṣe trairūpyā-
bhāvānna prakaraṇasamatvaṃ ca | tatratatrānvayadṛṣṭānteṣu yathoktasādhyasādhanasad-
bhāvāt vyatirekadṛṣṭānteṣu yathoktasādhyasādhanānāmabhāvācca na dṛṣṭānta-
doṣo'pīti |
nanu pratipakṣaprasādhakānumānānāṃ bahūnāṃ sadbhāvād viruddhāvya-
bhicāritva1mityaparo hetudoṣaḥ saṃpadyate bhavaduktahetūnām | tathā hi | vivā-
dādhyāsitāni śarīrāṇi ubhayābhimatenaikātmanā2dhiṣṭhitāni jīvaccharīra-
tvāt saṃpratipannaśarīravaditi cet | tatra adhiṣṭhitānīti ko'rtha ubhayābhi-
matena ātmanā āśritānīti vivakṣitaṃ tasya bhogāyatanānīti vā tena
saṃsṛṣṭānīti vā | na tāvat prathamapakṣaḥ kṣemakaraḥ ātmano nityadravyatve-
nānyāśritatvānabhyupagamāt | abhyupagame vā apasiddhāntaprasaṃgāt |
‘ṣaṇṇāmāśritatvamanyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ’ (praśastapādabhāṣya pṛ. 16) iti
svayamevābhidhānāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ śreyaskaraḥ | sakalaśarīrāṇāmu-
bhayābhimatasyātmano bhogāyatanatve yathā saṃmataśarīragatendriyajanita-
vartamānasukhaduḥkhasākṣātkāraḥ pratīyate tathā sakalaśarīragatendriyajanita-
vartamānasukhaduḥkhasākṣātkāro bhavedeva | na caivaṃ, tasmāt sakalaśarīrā-
viruddhena saha avyabhicāritkaṃ kiṃnāma viraddhaheturityarthaḥ |
ātmā tu ubhaya-
vādisaṃmato'sti vādastu eka eva aneka eva ātmā atra vartate |
ṇāmekātmabhogāyatanatvaṃ sādhyaṃ svānubhavapratyakṣabādhitamiti tatra pravarta-
mānasya hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt | tṛtīyapakṣo'pi na saṃbhāvyate |
ātmanaḥ sakalaśarīrasaṃsṛṣṭatvasya pratyakṣabādhitatvena hetoḥ kālātyayā-
padiṣṭatvāt | katham | yathā saṃpratipannaśarīre pādābhyāṃ gacchāmi pāṇibhyā-
māharāmi śrotrābhyāṃ śṛṇomi cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyāmi pāde me vedanā śirasi me
vedanā jaṭhare me sukhamityādi sakalopādhiṣu svasya saṃsargaḥ svānubhava-
pratyakṣeṇaiva pratīyate tathā sakalaśarīropādhisaṃsargo'pyasti cet tenaiva
pratyakṣeṇaiva pratīyeta | na ca pratīyate | tasmāt tannāstīti svānubhava-
pratyakṣeṇaiva niścīyata iti |
etena yadapyanumānamavādīt vītāni śarīrāṇi matrsaṃsargīṇi
śarīratvāt maccharīravat iti tadapi nirāsthat | svātmanaḥ sakalaśarīra-
saṃsargasya svānubhavapratyakṣabādhitatvena hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāviśeṣāt |
nanu mama sakalaśarīreṣvanusaṃdhānasadbhāvāt tatsaṃsargo'stīti niścīyata
iti cet tarhi tava pādatalalagnakaṇṭakoddhāraṇāya pāṇitalavyāpāravat
sakralamṛgapaśupakṣimanuṣyādīnāṃ duḥkhahetuparihārāya svasya vyāpāraprasaṃgāt |
kutaḥ | sakaladuḥkhānāṃ svānusaṃdhānagocaratvena svakīyaduḥkhatvāt | na caivaṃ
dṛśyate | tasmāt tava sakalaśarīrasaṃsargo nāstīti niścīyate | [52. ātmanaḥ ekatvanirāsaḥ |]
atha ātmā eka eva mano'nyatve sati sadā sparśarahitadravyatvāt
ākāśavaditi cet tatra pramātā pakṣīkriyate anyo vā | na tāvadādyaḥ pramā-
turekatvasya svānubhavapratyakṣabādhitatvena hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt |
kuta iti cet ekānekaśarīragatendriyajanitavartamānasukhaduḥkhapratyakṣābhyāṃ
pramātṛbhedasya svānubhavapratyakṣasiddhatvāt | kiṃ ca | pramātṛṛn pakṣīkṛtya
ekatvaṃ prasādhyate cen mṛgapaśupakṣimanuṣyādīnāṃ mātṛpitṛputrapautrabhrātṛ-
kalatrādīnāṃ vibhāgābhāvena eka eva sakalalokeṣu saṃkāyaḥ syāditi
atiprasajyate | apasiddhāntāpātaśca | kutaḥ | antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ
pramātṛ ityantaḥkaraṇānāmanantatvena pramātṛṛṇāmapyanantatvanirūpaṇāt | dvitī-
yapakṣe pramāturanyasyātmanaḥ pramāṇagocaratvābhāvādāśrayāsiddho hetvābhāsaḥ
syāt | vādino viśeṣyāsiddhaśca | vedāntapakṣe ātmano dravyatvābhāvāt |
atha ātmā eka eva vibhutvāt ākāśavaditi cenna | hetorasiddha-
tvāt | katham | ahaṃ jñānī ahaṃ sukhī ahamicchādveṣaprayatnavān ityaha-
mahamikayā svānubhavapratyakṣeṇa śarīramātra eva svātmanaḥ pratibhāsa-
mānatvāt | tato bāhye'pratibhāsamānatvācca | prāguktānekatvaprasādhakānu-
mānānāmasarvagatatvaprasādhakatvācca |
nanu ātmā eka eva amūrtatvāt ākāśavaditi cenna | hetoḥ kriyā-
bhirvyabhicārāt1 | atha tadvyavacchedārtham amūrtadravyatvādityucyata iti
cenna | dravyatvasya vādyasiddhatvena2 hetorviśeṣyāsiddhatvāt | atha ātmā
eka eva nityatvāt ākāśavaditi cenna | aparasāmānyairhetorvyabhicārāt3 |
atha tat parihārārthaṃ nityadravyatvādityucyata iti cenna | paramāṇubhirheto-
rvyabhicārāt | atha tadvyapohārtham anaṇutve sati nityadravyatvādityucyata
iti cenna | tathāpi dṛṣṭāntasya4 sādhanavikalatvāt | kuta iti cet
‘ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ ākāśād vāyuḥ vāyoragniḥ’ (taittirīya u.
2-1-1) ityādinā vedena ākāśasyotpattivināśakatvena kāryadravyatva-
nirūpaṇāt | tatra ekatvanityatvaniravayavatvavibhutvāmūrtatvāderasaṃbhavāt |
etena ātmā eka eva anaṇutve satyakāraṇakatvāt5 anaṇutve satyakāryatvāt
kriyā amūrtāsti paraṃtu anekā na |
ātmadravyasya vedāntimate nirguṇatvam |
aparasāmānyāni nityāni santi paraṃtu anekāni ghaṭatvapaṭatvādīni |

iti |

vidyābheda iti cenna | itaretarāśrayaprasaṃgāt | kutaḥ | yāvat pramātṛbhedo na
jāghaṭīti tāvadavidyābhedo'pi nopapanīpadyate, yāvadavidyābhedo nopapadyate
tāvat pramātṛbhedo na jāghaṭītīti | atha jñānapuṇyapāpavāsanārūpasaṃskāra-
kāryalakṣaṇa upādhiḥ kāryopādhiḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇa upādhiḥ kāraṇopādhiḥ |
bhedādavidyābheda iti cet tarhi tatsaṃskārabhedaḥ kuto jāyate | pramātṛ-
bhedāditi cet pramātṛbhedo'pi kuto jāyate | avidyābhedāditi cet
avidyābhedo'pi kuto jāyate | saṃskārabhedāditi cenna |
cakrakāśrayaprasaṃgāt | tathā hi | yāvadavidyābhedo nāsti tāvat pramātṛ-
medābhāvaḥ | yāvat pramātṛbhedo nāsti tāvat saṃskārabhedābhāvaḥ | yāvat
saṃskārabhedo nāsti tāvadavidyābhedābhāvaḥ | yāvadavidyābhedo nāsti tāvat
pramātṛbhedābhāva iti | atha avidyāyā bhedābhāvena ekatve'pi pramātṛbhedo
bhaviṣyati iti cet na | upādhibhūtāyā avidyāyā ekatve upādhīyamāna-
syātmano'pyekatve pramātṛbhedasyānupapatteḥ | nanu avidyāyāḥ svabhāvato bheda
iti cet tarhi pramātṛṇāmapi svabhāvata eva bhedasadbhāve ko virodhaḥ | atha
suparṇaṃ1 viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti | (ṛgveda 10-114-5)
iti śrutivirodha iti cenna | tacchruteḥ paramātmaikyapratipādanaparatvena jīvā-
tmaikyapratipādanābhāvāt | śruteḥ prāmāṇyābhāvasya prāgeva pramāṇaiḥ samarthi-
tatvācca | athāntaḥkaraṇameva pramātṛbhedakaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | antaḥkaraṇaṃ na
pramātṛbhedakam avidyākāryatvāt karaṇatvāt jaḍatvāt janyatvāt cakṣu-
ātmānam |
rādivaditi pramāṇavirodhāt | anyathā1 cakṣurādibuddhīndriyavāgādikarme-
ndriyaśirojaṭharādyaṅgopāṅgādibhyaḥ pramātṛbhedaḥ prasajyeta ityekaṃ śarīraṃ
bahubhiḥ pramātṛbhiradhiṣṭhitaṃ syāt | tathā ca vibhinnābhiprāyānekapramātṛbhiḥ
preritaṃ śarīraṃ sarvadikkriyamunmathyeta akriyaṃ vā prasajyeta | nanu antaḥ-
karaṇameva pramātṛbhedakaṃ na cakṣurādaya iti cenna | jaḍatvajanyatvakaraṇatvā-

pramātṛbhedaḥ svīkartavyaḥ | [54. pramāṇaprameyabhedasamarthanam |]
tathā pramāṇapramitiprameyabhedo'pi paramārtha ityaṅgīkartavyaḥ | tathā
pramāṇaṃ pramitirmeyaṃ pramāteti catuṣṭayam |
vihāyānyat kathaṃ siddhyet tatsiddhau mānavarjanāt4 ||

syāt1 | tathāpyabādhyatve prapañcasyāpyabādhyatvaṃ syāt | tasmāt pramātṛ-
pramāṇapramitiprameyameva tattvaṃ tatonyat tattvaṃ nāstīti pramāṇatayaiva
niścīyate | [55. vedāntamate pramātṛsvarūpāyuktatā |]
tathāpi tanmate pramātā vicāryamāṇo na jāghaṭyate | tathā hi |
prapañco mithyā dṛśyatvāt svapnaprapañcavadityuktatvāt |
pūrṇabodhasvarūpasya pramātṛtvam upādhyavaṣṭabdhapradeśamātrasya vā | prathamapakṣe
loke eka eva pramātā syāt, nānyaḥ pramātā pratīyeta | pūrṇabodhasvarūpasya
ekatvāt | na caivaṃ, mṛgapaśupakṣimanuṣyādīnāṃ anekapramātṛṛṇāmupalambhāt |
kiṃ ca | svarūpasya pramātṛtve kartṛtvaṃ bhoktṛtvaṃ bādhyatvaṃ ca prasajyate |
tathāstīti1 cenna | apasiddhāntaprasaṃgāt | katham | ‘sākṣī cetā kevalo
nirguṇaśca’ ityakartṛtvanirūpaṇāt | ‘anaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti’
ityabhoktṛtvanirūpaṇāt | ‘nityaṃ jñānamānandaṃ brahma’ ityabādhyatvanirūpa-
ṇācca | upādhyavaṣṭabdhapradeśamātrasya pramātṛtve sa ca upādhiḥ sarvagataḥ
syādasarvagato vā | na tāvat prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ upādherupādhīyamānasyātmano'pi2
sarvagatatve jñātāhaṃ sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyahamityeka eva jīvaḥ sarvaloke ahaṃ-
pratyayavedyatvena pratīyeta | na caivaṃ pratīyate | api tu śarīramātre eva jñātāhaṃ
sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyaham icchādveṣaprayatnavānahamityahamahamikayā svānubhava-
pratyakṣeṇa pratīyamānatvādātmanaḥ sarvagatatve'pi upādhiḥ3 śarīrāvaṣṭabdhapradeśe
eva nānyatretyaṅgīkartavyam | tathā ca śarīrasyānyatra gamane tena saha
brahmasvarūpasya kartṛtvādikamastīti |
ātmanaḥ guṇādiḥ upādhiḥ tatsarvagatatvāt |
sukhaduḥkhādirupādhiḥ |
upādherapi gamanāt pūrvamupādhyavaṣṭabdhapradeśasya pramātṛtvaṃ vinaśyatyeva
kevalam | nanu prāgupādhyavaṣṭabdhapradeśo'pi tenopādhinā sahānyatra gacchatīti
tatpradeśapramātṛtvaṃ na vinaśyatīti cenna | tadasaṃbhavāt | kutaḥ
vīto deśo1 na yātyeva cidrūpatvāt svarūpavat |
deśo'yaṃ na svayaṃ yāti pradeśatvāt khadeśavat ||
iti pramāṇabādhitatvāt2 | tasmādupādhireva kāyena saha deśāntaraṃ gacchati |
tenopādhinā yāvaccaitanyaṃ vyāptaṃ tāvanmātrameva caitanyaṃ pramātā bhavet | tathā
ca yasmāt pradeśādupādhirnivartate tatpradeśasya pramātṛtvavināśaḥ aparaṃ yaṃ
pradeśamupādhiḥ prāpnoti tatpradeśasya pramātṛtvenotpattiriti yadā yadā
śarīrasya deśāntaraprāptistadā tadā pūrvapūrvapramātṛtvavināśaḥ apūrvāpūrvasya
pramāturutpattirityekasmin dehe bahūnāṃ pramātaṇāṃ vināśanāt apareṣāṃ ca
bahūnāṃ pramātṛṇāmutpatteśca kathameko dehāntaraṃ vrajet |
tato dehāntaraprāptiḥ pramātaṇāṃ na vidyate |
yataḥ pūrvaśarīreṇa kṛtakarmaphalaṃ bhajet ||
prāgupādhyavaṣṭabdhapradeśaḥ |

yaḥ kartā puṇyapāpasya taṃ jīvaṃ naiva bhojayet3 |

antaḥkaraṇamevaitat kartradṛṣṭasya dehataḥ |
prāpya dehāntaraṃ bhoktṛ tatphalasya tadeva4 cet ||
na | ātmakalpanāvaiyarthyaprasaṃgāt | tathā hi | antaḥkaraṇasyaivādṛṣṭādikartṛtvaṃ

parikalpyate | tetāntaḥkaraṇenaiva paryāptatvāt | kiṃ ca,
yadi dehāntaraṃ pramātā na gacchati tarhi pramātā kathaṃ dharmādyanuṣṭhāne pravartate api
tu na |
svargādiprāptyartham anutiṣṭhati dharmamācarati evaṃ bhūtasyānuṣṭhāturasaṃbhavāt pramātā
dehāntaraṃ na vrajati tarhi kimarthaṃ dharmaḥ kriyate ityabhiprāyaḥ |

antaḥkaraṇameva |
na vītamantaḥkaraṇaṃ kartṛ bhoktṛvitkaraṇatvataḥ |
jāḍyādutpattimattvācca cakṣurādighaṭādivat ||

jāghaṭyate | tathā tasya bhavād bhavāntaraprāptirapi nopapanīpadyate
ityāvedayati |
antaḥkaraṇaṃ vimataṃ paradehaṃ na gacchati |

atha sparśanādīndriyāṇāmapyeteṣāṃ bhavāntaraprāptisadbhāvāt sādhyavikalo
dṛṣṭānta iti cenna |
sparśanādīndriyaṃ dharmi paradehaṃ na gacchati |
indriyatvād vināśitvāt janmavattvācca pāṇivat2 ||
iti bādhakapramāṇasadbhāvāt |

saṃbhave'pi hyabaddhatvāt kasya mokṣaḥ prasajyate ||

brahmāṇḍodarajīvānāmanantatvādaśūnyatā || iti |
tathā teṣāmanantatvena pratiśarīraṃ bhedepi sarveṣāṃ sarvagatatvameva, na śarīra-

rahitatvamamūrtatvamiti cet tadā dravyatve sati rūpādirahitatvādityuktaṃ

rūpādirahitatvasya sadbhāve'pi sarvagatatvābhāvāt | nanu asarvagatadravya-
parimāṇaṃ mūrtatvaṃ tatpratiṣedhena sarvagatadravyaparimāṇamamūrtatvamiti cet
tadā dravyatve sati sarvagatatvādityuktaṃ syāt | tathā ca sādhyasamatvena
naiyāyikamate manasaḥ aṇuparimāṇatvam |
svarūpāsiddho hetvābhāsaḥ syāt | nanu ātmā sarvagataḥ nityatvādākāśa-
vaditi cenna | hetoḥ paramāṇubhirvyabhicārāt1 | atha tadvyavacchedārthamamū-

diti viśeṣyamupādīyata iti cenna | tatrāpyamūrtatve satīti korthaḥ | rūpādi-
rahitatve satīti vivakṣitaṃ sarvagatatve satīti vā | prathamapakṣe manasā

atha ātmā sarvagataḥ sparśādirahitatvāt ākāśavaditi cenna | guṇakriyā-

iti cenna | ghaṭapaṭādikāryadravyāṇāmutpannaprathamasamaye sparśādirahitatvena
hetorvyabhicārāt | atha tadvyavacchedārthaṃ sadāsparśarahitadravyatvādityucyata
paramāṇūnāṃ nityatve'pi sarvagatatvābhāvaḥ |
manaso rūpādirahitatve sati
nityadravyatve'pi sarvagatatvābhāvaḥ |
iti cenna | tathāpi hetormanasā vyabhicārāt1 | atha tadvyavacchedārthaṃ
manonyatve sati sadā sparśarahitadravyatvādityucyata iti cenna | tathāpi
hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt |
tat kuta iti cet pādābhyāṃ gacchāmi pāṇibhyāmāharāmi cakṣurbhyāṃ

teṣāṃ svātmanā saṃyoge'pi svakīyatvābhāvāt tatra tathā na pratīyata
manasaḥ sadā sparśarahitatve'pi sarvagatatvābhāvaḥ |
buddhisukhaduḥkhādi |
sakalavanaspatitrasādiśarīrendriyāntaḥkaraṇānām |
iti cet tarhi etaccharīrendriyāntaḥkaraṇānāṃ svakīyatvaṃ kautaskutam |
svakīyādṛṣṭakṛtatvāt svakīyatvamiti cet tarhi tadadṛṣṭasyāpi svakīyatvaṃ
kautaskutam | svakīyaśarīrendriyāntaḥkaraṇavyāpāreṇa kṛtatvāditi cet
tarhi itaretarāśrayaḥ | atha taccharīrādikaṃ prāktanasvakīyādṛṣṭakṛtaṃ tadapi
prāktanasvakīyaśarīrādikṛtamityādyaṅgīkārānnetaretarāśraya iti cenna |
taccharīrādisaṃtateradṛṣṭādisaṃtateśca aviśeṣeṇa sarvātmasaṃbandhe svakīya-

yatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | tasya nityasarvagataikatvena sarvātmasādhāraṇatvāt

mānasapratyakṣeṇaiva niścīyata iti kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetvābhāso niścitaḥ
syāt | etena ātmā sarvagataḥ anaṇutve sati nityadravyatvāt anaṇutve sati
niravayavadravyatvāt anaṇutve satyakhaṇḍadravyatvāt nityatve sati dravyā-
nārambhakadravyatvāt anaṇutve satyakāraṇakadravyatvāt anaṇutve satya-
kāryadravyatvāt anaṇutve satyavayavairanārabdhadravyatvāt ākāśavadityā-

sarvagatatvābhāvasya niścitatvena teṣāṃ hetūnāṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāviśeṣāt | [57. sarvagatatve saṃsārāyuktatā |]

adravyatvāt āśritatvāt paratantraikarūpatvāt rūpādivaditi ca pramāṇa-
sadbhāvāt sāmānyaṃ sarvatra sarvagataṃ na bhavatīti niścīyate |
nanu ata eva svavyaktisarvagatatvamaṅgīkriyate sarveṣāṃ sāmānyānāṃ
svavyaktisaṃbaddhatvena pratīyamānatvāditi cenna | vyaktīnāṃ loke sarvatra sadbhāvena
tatsarvagatatve'pi sarvasarvagatapakṣādaviśeṣāt | kiṃ ca | svavyaktisarva-
gatatve svavyaktīnāmantarāle'pi tat sāmānyamulapalabhyeta | na copalabhyate,
tasmādantarāle nāstīti niścīyate | nanu antarāle vyañjakavyaktīnāma1-
bhāvānnopalabhyate na tvasattvāditi cenna | vītaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyaktyantarāle
asadeva āśritatvenaiva2 pratīyamānatvāt rūpavaditi pramāṇasadbhāvāt |
vyaktyantarāle sāmānyasya sadbhāve sāmānyānāmanāśritatvenāvasthāna-
prasaṃgācca | sāmānyaṃ nityadravyam anāśritatvenāvasthitatvāt ākāśavat |
kiṃ ca | vyaktyutpattau tatra sthitaṃ sāmānyaṃ samavaiti anyasmādāgataṃ vā
vyaktyā sahotpadyamānaṃ vā | prathamapakṣe vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ sāmānyasya anā-
śritatvaṃ syāt | tathā ca sāmānyaṃ nityadravyam anāśritatvāt paramāṇuva-
ghaṭapaṭādīnām |
ṣaṇṇāmāśritatvamanyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ iti naiyāyikaḥ |
dityatiprasajyate | atha anyasmādāgataṃ samavaitīti cet tarhi sāmānyasya
sakriyatvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | tathā ca sāmānyamasarvagatadravyaṃ sakriyatvāt
meghādivadityatiprasajyate | atha vyaktyā sahotpadyamānaṃ samavaiti cet tarhi
sāmānyamanityam utpadyamānatvāt vidyudādivadityatiprasajyate | atha
sarvo'pyatiprasaṃgaḥ aṅgīkriyata iti cenna | apasiddhāntāpātāt | tathā
vyaktināśe tadgataṃ sāmānyaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhati anyatra gacchati vyaktyā saha
vinaśyati vā | prathamapakṣe sāmānyasyānāśritatvādatiprasaṃgaḥ1 syāt |
dvitīyapakṣe sakriyatvena asarvagatadravyatvādatiprasaṃgaḥ2 syāt | tṛtīyapakṣe
sāmānyasyānityatvādatiprasaṃgaḥ syāt | tasmāt sāmānyaṃ svavyakti-
sarvagatamapi nopapanīpadyate | tathā hi | sāmānyaṃ vyaktivyatiriktaṃ3 na
bhavati tadanyatvenāpratīyamānatvāt4 vyaktisvarūpavat | tathā paṭo'yaṃ paṭo'ya-
mityanugatapratyayaḥ nityavyāpyekavastuviṣayo na bhavati | pratipiṇḍaṃ kṛtsna-
nityadravyatvaṃ syāt |
anityatvaṃ syāt |
vyakteḥ pṛthag na bhavati |
vyakti vinā |
svarūpapadārthagrāhitvāt1 vyaktiviṣayapratyayavat | tathā paṭo'yaṃ paṭo'yamitya-
nugatapratyayaḥ nityavyāpyekavastuviṣayo na bhavati anugatapratyayatvāt
sadṛśeṣveva pravartamānatvāt geho'yaṃ goho'yamityanugatapratyayavaditi | tataśca
kenacit sādṛśyavyatirekeṇāparaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāstyeva | samānābhidhāna-
samānapratyayasamānavyavahāragocarāḥ samānāḥ, samānānāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānyaṃ,
sadṛśānāṃ bhāvaḥ sādṛśyamiti nirukteḥ | kenacidekena dharmeṇa samānatva-
sadbhāvasyaiva sāmānyatvāt | nanu anugataikasāmānyābhāve ghaṭagavādi-
śabdānāṃ saṃketo na yoyujyate vyaktīnāmānantyena saṃketayitumaśakyatvā-
diti cenna | yo yaḥ kaścana evaṃvidhapṛthubudhnodarādyākāraḥ padārthaḥ sa
sarvo'pi ghaṭaśabdavācya iti jānīhi, yo yaḥ kaścana evaṃvidhasāsnādimān
padārthaḥ sa sarvo'pi gośabdavācya iti jānīhi iti saṃketayituṃśakyatvāt
rāśigrahādiśabdasaṃketavat |
ghaṭo'yam iti anugatapratyayaḥ sāmānyagrāhyo bhavati cet tarhi pratighaṭaṃ sakalasva-
rūpagrāhī na bhavati kutaḥ ekaṃ sāmānyam ekasmin ghaṭe sthitaṃ bhavati tadā dṛśyate ca ghaṭaṃ
prati sakalasvarūpagrāhitvam |
[62. sāmānyasamavāyayoḥ nityatvanirāsaḥ |]
tathā sāmānyasya nityatvamapi na bobhūyate | tathāhi | sāmānya-
manityam utpattivināśavattvāt paṭādivaditi | nanu sāmānyasya
utpattivināśavattvamasiddhamiti cenna | sāmānyaṃ svāśrayotpattau utpadyate
āśritatvāt adravyatvāt paratantraikarūpatvāt paṭarūpādivaditi | tathā
sāmānyaṃ svāśrayavināśād vinaśyati paratantraikarūpatvāt āśritatvāt
adravyatvāt gandhavaditi sāmānyasya nityatvamapi na jāghaṭīti | nanu
adravyatvāditi hetoḥ samavāyena vyabhicārānna tataḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ1 |
kutaḥ | samavāyasya adravyatvasadbhāve'pi svāśrayavināśād vināśā-
bhāvāt svāśrayotpattyā utpattyabhāvācca | tadapi kutaḥ | tasya samavāyasya
nityatvasarvagatatvaikatvābhyupagamāditi cenna | samavāyasya nityatvaikatva
sarvagatatvānupapatteḥ | tathā hi | samavāyaḥ nityo na bhavati asaṃkhyā-
parimāṇatve2 sati paratantraikarūpatvāt rūpavat | atha samavāyasya para-
tantraikarūpatvamasiddhamiti cenna | samavāyaḥ paratantraikarūpaḥ āśritatvāt
saṃbandhatvāt utpattivināśavattvāt saṃyogavaditi samavāyasya paratantraika-
rūpatvasiddheḥ | nanu tathāpi samavāyasya utpattivināśavattvamapyasiddhamiti
cenna | samavāyaḥ svāśrayotpattāvutpadyate paratantraikarūpatvāt āśritatvāt
anityatvaṃ sādhyam |
saṃkhyāparimāṇenityagate varjayitvā nityadravyagatā saṃkhyā
nityagataṃ parimāṇaṃ nityam |
rūpādivat, saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavat | tathā samavāyaḥ svāśrayavināśād
vinaśyati paratantraikarūpatvāt āśritatvāt saṃyogavaditi samavāyasyotpa-
ttivināśavattvasiddheranityatvasiddhiḥ | nanu saṃyogasya paratantraikarūpatvāsiddheḥ
sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭānta iti cenna | saṃyogaḥ paratantraikarūpaḥ guṇatvāt
āśritatvāt rūpavaditi saṃyogasya paratantraikarūpatvasiddheḥ |
tathā samavāyaḥ sarvagato na bhavati sakalamūrtimaddravyasaṃyogarahita-
tvāt paṭavat | nanu samavāyasya sakalamūrtimaddravyasaṃyogarahitatvamapya-
siddhamiti cenna | samavāyaḥ sakalamurtimaddravyasaṃyogarahitaḥ mahāpari-
māṇānadhikaraṇatvāt paṭādivaditi tatsiddheḥ | atha samavāyasya mahā-
parimāṇānadhikaraṇatvamapyasiddhamiti cenna | samavāyaḥ mahāparimāṇādhi-
karaṇo na bhavati adravyatvāt āśritatvāt paratantraikarūpatvāt rūpādivat
saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavaditi mahāparimāṇānadhikaraṇatvasiddheḥ | tathā samavāyaḥ
sarvagato na bhavati mahāparimāṇānadhikaraṇatvāt adravyatvāt āśritatvāt
paratantraikarūpatvāt rūpādivat, saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavaditi ca | tathā
samavāyaḥ eko na bhavati sakalamūrtimaddravyasaṃyogarahitatvāt mahāpari-
māṇānadhikaraṇatvāt adravyatvāt āśritatvāt paratantraikarūpatvāt rūpādi-
vat saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavaditi samavāyasya nityatvavibhutvaikatvānupapattireva
syāt | nanu sattāsāmānyasyāparatantraikarūpatve'pyanekatvābhāvādanaikāntiko
heturiti cenna | sattāsāmānyam anekaṃ bhavati adravyatvāt āśritatvāt
sakalamūrtimaddravyasaṃyogarahitatvāt mahāparimāṇānadhikaraṇatvāt para-
tantraikarūpatvāt rūpādivaditi sattāsāmānyasyānekatvasiddheḥ | tathaivānya-
sāmānyasyāpyanekatvasiddhiriti nānaikāntiko heturiti nirduṣṭebhyo
hetubhyaḥ samavāyasyānityatvāsarvagatatvānekatvasiddhireva syāt | [63. prābhākarasaṃmatasamavāyasvarūpaniṣedhaḥ |]
nanu tathaiva samavāyasyānityatvamasarvagatatvamanekatvamastu, asmābhirapi
tathaivāṅgīkriyata iti prābhākarāḥ pratyavocan | te'pyayuktijñā eva | samavāya-
syānityatve utpattisāmagryā asaṃbhavāt1 | kuta iti cet samavāyasyo-
tpattāvupādānasahakārikāraṇānāmasaṃbhavāt | nanu avayavāvayaviprabhṛti2-
samavāyibhyāṃ nimittakāraṇabhūtābhyāṃ samavāyaḥ samutpadyata iti cenna |
bhāvarūpakāryāṇāṃ nimittakāraṇamātreṇa samutpatterasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi |
vivādādhyāsitaḥ saṃbandhaḥ3 samavāyikāraṇamantareṇa notpadyate bhāvatve
sati4 kāryatvāt paṭādivat, saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavat | tathā vivādāpannaḥ
anityatve sati utpattimattvaṃ bhavati tadabhāvaḥ |
prabhṛtiśabdena guṇaguṇinau
kriyākriyāvantau jātivyaktī |
samavāyaḥ |

iti padārthāḥ |
saṃbandhaḥ asamavāyikāraṇaṃ vinā notpadyate bhāvatve sati kāryatvāt
ghaṭavat, saṃbandhatvāt saṃyogavaditi ca | tathā vītaḥ saṃbandhaḥ nimitta-
kāraṇamātrānnotpadyate bhāvatve sati kāryatvāt paṭādivat saṃbandhatvāt
saṃyogavat iti ca | samavāyasyānityatvāṅgīkāre utpattisāmagryā asaṃbha-
vāt tasya samavāyasyāpyasaṃbhava eveti na prābhākarāṅgīkāro'pi śreyān | [64. samavāyasvarūpāsaṃbhavaḥ |]
kiṃ ca | parābhyupagamena samavāyo'stītyaṅgīkṛtya etat sarvamuktam |
vicāryamāṇe tasya samavāyasyaivāsaṃbhavāt | nanu avayavāvayavinorguṇa-
guṇinoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ kriyākriyāvatoryaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa samavāya
ityurarīkartavyāmiti cet tarhi samavāyibhyāṃ1 samavāyaḥ saṃbaddhaḥ san
pravartate asaṃbaddho vā | asaṃbaddhaścedanayorayaṃ2 samavāya iti vyapadeśānu-
papattireva syāt asaṃbaddhatvāt sahyavindhyavaditi | atha samavāyaḥ sama-
vāyibhyāṃ saṃbaddhaḥ san pravartate iti tarhi svataḥ saṃbandhāntareṇa vā |
atha saṃbandhāntareṇa saṃbaddhaḥ san pravartata iti cet tadapi saṃbandhāntaraṃ
svasaṃbandhiṣu saṃbandhāntareṇa saṃbaddhaṃ sat pravartate tadapi saṃbandhāntaraṃ
avayavāvayavibhyāṃ guṇaguṇibhyām |
avayavāvayavinoḥ |
saṃbandhātareṇa saṃbaddhaṃ sat svasaṃbandhiṣu pravartata ityanavasthā syāt | atha
samavāyaḥ samavāyibhyāṃ svataḥ saṃbaddhaḥ eva pravartata iti cet tarhi yathā
samavāyaḥ samavāyiṣu svataḥ saṃbaddha eva pravartata iti parikalpyate tathā
avayaveṣu avayavinaḥ guṇiṣu guṇāḥ viśeṣeṣu sāmānyāni asarvagatadravyeṣu
kriyāśca svata eva saṃbaddhāḥ pravarteran | kiṃ samavāyaparikalpanayā prayojanam |
prayogaśca | avayaviguṇasāmānyakriyāḥ svāśrayeṣu1 svataḥ saṃbaddhā eva
pravartante āśritatvāt paratantraikarūpatvāt samavāyavaditi avayavāvayavi-
prabhṛtīnāmanyanirapekṣatayā2 svabhāvasaṃbandhaḥ pramāṇasiddhaḥ syāt |
nanu ‘ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāṃ ya ihedaṃ3 pratyayahetuḥ saṃbandhaḥ
sa samavāyaḥ’ (praśastapādabhāṣya pṛ. 58) | iti lakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt samavā-
yo'stītyūrīkartavyamiti cet na | tallakṣaṇasya vicāryamāṇe asaṃbhavadoṣa-
duṣṭatvāt | tathā hi | ayutasiddhānāmiti ko'rthaḥ | nanu pṛthak siddhāḥ
yutasiddhā ityucyante, apṛthak siddhā ayutasiddhā iti kathyante teṣāmayuta-
siddhānāṃ saṃbandhaḥ samavāya iti cenna | avayavāvayavinorguṇaguṇinoḥ
sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ kriyātadvatoḥ pṛthak pṛthak niṣpannatvena yutasiddhatvā-
avayavaguṇiviśeṣāsarvagatadravyeṣu |
samavāyanirapekṣatayā |
iha tantuṣu ayaṃ paṭaḥ |
dayutasiddhatvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | avayavāstantavaḥ aṃśubhyo niṣpannāḥ
avayavī paṭastantubhyo niṣpanna iti avayavāvayavinoḥ pṛthag niṣpannatvena
yutasiddhatvādayutasiddhatvāsaṃbhava eva | tathā paṭe rūpādayo guṇāḥ sama-
vāyikāraṇāt paṭāt asamavāyikāraṇebhyastantugatarūpādibhyaḥ kuvindakara-
vyāpārādinimittakāraṇācca niṣpannāḥ | paṭādayo guṇino'pi samavāyi-
kāraṇebhyastantubhyaḥ asamavāyikāraṇebhyastantūnāmātānavitānarūpaviśiṣṭa-
saṃyogebhyaḥ kuvindakaravyāpāranimittakāraṇācca niṣpannāḥ | iti guṇa-
guṇinoḥ pṛthag niṣpannatvena yutasiddhatvābhāvādayutasiddhatvāsaṃbhava eva
syāt | tathā sattādisāmānyānāṃ nityatvena siddhatvāt dravyādiviśe-
ṣāṇāṃ svakāraṇakalāpānniṣpannatvācca sāmānyaviśeṣayorapi pṛthak niṣpa-
nnatven yutasiddhatvāt ayutasiddhatvāsaṃbhava eva syāt | tathā paṭādyasarva-
gatadravyaṃ tantvādyupādānakāraṇādinā samutpadyate paṭādīnāṃ kriyā ca paṭādyu-
pādānakāraṇādinā samutpadyata iti kriyātadvatorapi pṛthag niṣpannatvena
yutasiddhatvādayutasiddhatvāsaṃbhava eva syāt iti | kiṃ ca | avayavāvayavi-
prabhṛtīnāṃ bhinnadeśabhinnakālabhinnakartṛbhinnopādānādikāraṇairniṣpannatvād
yutasiddhatvameva syāt nāyutasiddhatvam | tathāvidhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānā1-
mihedaṃpratyayahetuḥ saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaścediha bhūtale ghaṭastiṣṭhati iha paṭe
devadatta āste ityādipratyayahetusaṃbandho'pi samavāyaḥ syādityativyāptiḥ
samavāyalakṣaṇasya syāt | tasmāt samavāyalakṣaṇasyānupapatteḥ samavāya-
syāpyasaṃbhava eva syāt |
tathā ādhāryadhārabhūtānāmiti ko'rthaḥ | nanu ādhāro nāma adhastana-
bhāge avasthitaṃ dravyam ādhāryāstasyopari vartamānāḥ avayaviguṇasāmānya-
kriyāḥ | tathā hi | iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ, iha paṭe rūpādayaḥ, iha paṭeṣu paṭatvaṃ
sāmānyam, iha paṭe utkṣepaṇādikriyāḥ pravartanta iti ādhāryādhārabhāvapratī-
tiriti cenna | teṣāṃ bhavaduktādhāryādhārabhāvābhāvāt | kuta iti cet paṭa-
syoparitanabhāge'pi tantūnāṃ sadbhāvadarśanāt adhobhāge'pi paṭasya sadbhā-
vadarśanāt | kiṃ ca | ātānavitānarūpeṇa viśiṣṭasaṃyogayuktatantūnāmeva
paṭābhidhānapratyayavyavahāragocaratvena tato'tiriktasya paṭasyānupalabdheśca,
tṛṇātiriktatṛṇakūṭānupalabdhivat māṣādiriktarāśyanupalabdhivacca | tathā2
śākhāsu vṛkṣa ityatrāpi vṛkṣasyādhobhāge śākhānāmapratīteḥ śākhānāmupari
vṛkṣasyāpratīteśca avayavā ādhārāḥ avayavinaḥ ādhāryā ityanupapatteḥ ava-
pūrvoktānāṃ ādhārādheyatvaṃ nirākṛtam |
naiyāyikaḥ nanu yathā iha tantuṣu
avayavabhūteṣu paṭaḥ ucyate tathā evamapi ucyate śākhāsu avayavabhūtāsu vṛkṣaḥ ityādi |

gotvaṃ jātiḥ gaurvyaktiḥ |

bhavati indriyatvāt tvagindriyavat, jñānotpattau karaṇatvāt manovaditi

tat pratyayasyendriyārthasaṃyogābhāvo'pi tenaiva niścita iti hetoḥ kālātyayā-

viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ ca saṃbandhaṃ laukikīṃ sthitim |

pramāṇapadārthe pratipāditatvāt punarukta eva |
tathā pakṣahetudṛṣṭāntopanayanigamanānyanumānasyāvayavāḥ pañca | tatra
saṃdigdhasādhyadharmārdhāraḥ pakṣaḥ anityaḥ śabda iti | vyāptimān pakṣadharmo
hetuḥ kṛtakatvāditi | sādhyavyāptaṃ sādhanaṃ yatra pradarśyate so'nvayadṛṣṭāntaḥ
kṛtakaḥ so'nityo yathā ghaṭa iti | sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvo yatra kathyate
sa vyatirekadṛṣṭānto yannānityaṃ tanna kṛtakaṃ yathā vyometi | pakṣadharmatva-
pradarśanārthaṃ hetorupasaṃhāra upanayaḥ kṛtakaścāyamiti | uktanirṇayārthaṃ prati-
jñāyāḥ punarvacanaṃ nigamanaṃ tasmādanitya iti | iti cenna | teṣāmanumāna-
pramāṇe pratipāditatvena punaruktatvāt | kiṃ ca | anumānāṅgānāmapi padārtha-
tvāṅgīkāre sparśanarasanaghrāṇacakṣuḥśrotrāṇāṃ1 tatsaṃnikarṣāṇāṃ saṃketasādṛ-

atha vyāptibalamavalambya parasyāniṣṭāpādanaṃ tarka iti cet sa ca
ubhayapramāṇaprasiddhavyāptikaḥ anyatarapramāṇaprasiddhavyāptiko vā | na
tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ tathā cet tasya tarkatvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | vītastarko na
bhavati ubhayapramāṇaprasiddhavyāptikatvāt dhūmānumānavat | tathā vivādā-
dhyāsitaṃ pramāṇameva ubhayapramāṇaprasiddhavyāptikatvāt dhūmānumānavat iti
ca | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ kakṣīkriyate tarhi vādipramāṇaprasiddhavyāptiko vā
prativādipramāṇaprasiddhaprāptiko vā | na tāvadādyaḥ vādipramāṇaprasiddhavyāpti-
kāt tarkāt parasyāniṣṭamāpādayitumaśakteḥ | kutaḥ parasya mūlavyāpti-
pratipattyabhāvāt | atha paraprasiddhavyāptyā parasyāniṣṭāpādanaṃ tarka iti cet
tadasmābhirapyaṅgīkriyate | tathāpi vyāptipūrvakatvenotpannatvād anumānā-
nnārthāntaram |
atha idamitthamevetyavadhāraṇajñānaṃ nirṇayapadārtha iti cet tadapi
pratyakṣādipramitireva, nārthāntaram |
atha ‘pramāṇatarkasādhanopalambhaḥ siddhāntāviruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ
pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vādaḥ | yathoktopapannacchalajātinigrahasthānasādhano
jalpaḥ | sa eva pratipakṣasthāpanāhīno vitaṇḍā |’ ityetattrayāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ
kathāvicāreṇa vicāritaṃ draṣṭavyam | ‘hetulakṣaṇarahitāḥ hetuvadābhāsamānā
hetvābhāsāḥ’ asiddhādayaste ca kathāvicāre vicāritā draṣṭavyāḥ | teṣā-
mapi pṛthak padārthatve sādharmyavaidharmyābhyāmuktadvādaśavidhadṛṣṭāntānāmapi1
padārthatvaṃ prasajyate | tathā vacanavighāto'rthāntaraparikalpanayā chalaṃ tat
trividham | prayukte hetau pratipakṣasamīkaraṇābhiprāyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ2 jātiḥ
sā caturviṃśatiprakārā | vādiprativādinoranyatarasya parājayanimittaṃ
nigrahasthānaṃ tacca dvāviṃśatiprakāram |
ityetat sarvaṃ kathāvicāre prapañcitaṃ draṣṭavyam | eteṣāmapi padārthatve
lokaśāpākrośāsabhyavacanāpadabhiyogādīnāmapi padārthatvaṃ syādityati-
prasajyate | kiṃ ca | saṃśayādīnāṃ pramāṇagocaratvena prameyatvasaṃbhavāt pramāṇaṃ
anvayavyatirekāṇāṃ dvādaśa prakārāḥ |
yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt ghaṭavat
ityukte yathā ghaṭavat kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ tathā ghaṭavat samavāyo'pi bhavati |
prameyamiti padārthadvayameva jāghaṭyate | tato nānyat padārthāntaraṃ yoyujyate |
atha prayojanavaśāt saṃśayādīnāṃ pṛthak kathanamiti cet tarhi caturvidha-
pramāṇānāṃ dvādaśavidhaprameyānāṃ pañcavidhāvayavānāṃ ṣaṭhetvābhāsānāṃ dvādaśa-
vidhadṛṣṭāntābhāsānāṃ triprakāracchalānāṃ caturviṃśatividhajātīnāṃ dvāviṃśa-
tividhanigrahasthānānāṃ ca pratyekaṃ prayojanabhedasadbhāvāt ṣaṇṇavatipadārthāḥ
prasajyeran | ṣaḍindriyapadārthapadasaṃbandhaṣaḍbuddhi sukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatna-
saṃsargādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ prayojanasadbhāvāt padārthāḥ anantāḥ prasajyeran | no
cet ṣoḍaśāpi mā bhūvan | evaṃ naiyāyikoktaprakāreṇa ṣoḍaśapadārthānāṃ
yāthātmyāsaṃbhavena tadviṣayajñānasya tattvajñānatvābhāvānna tato niḥśreya-
sādhigama iti sthitam | [76. yogatrayavicāraḥ |]
nanu bhaktiyogaḥ kriyāyogaḥ jñānayoga iti yogatrayairyathāsaṃkhyaṃ
sālokyasārūpyasāmīpyasāyujyamuktirbhavati | tatra maheśvaraḥ svāmī svayaṃ
bhṛtya iti taccitto bhūtvā yāvajjīvaṃ tasya pari caryākaraṇaṃ bhaktiyogaḥ |
tasmāt1 sālokyamuktirbhavati | tapaḥsvādhyāyānuṣṭhānaṃ kriyāyogaḥ | tatro-
nmādakāmādivyapohārtham ādhyātmikādiduḥkhasahiṣṇutvaṃ tapaḥ | praśānta-
mantrasyeśvaravācino'bhyāsaḥ svādhyāyaḥ | tadubhayamapi kleśakarmaparikṣayāya
samādhilābhārthaṃ cānuṣṭheyam | tasmāt kriyāyogāt sārūpyaṃ2 sāmīpyaṃ vā
muktirbhavati | viditapadapadārthasyeśvarapraṇidhānaṃ jñānayogaḥ parameśvaratattvasya
prabandhenānucintanaṃ paryālocanamīśvarapraṇidhānam | tasya yogasya yama-
niyamāsanaprāṇāyāmapratyāhāradhāraṇādhyānasamādhayo'ṣṭāvaṅgāni | tatra deśa-
kālāvasthābhiraniyatāḥ3 puruṣasya śuddhivṛddhihetavo yamāḥ ahiṃsābrahmacaryā-
steyādayaḥ | deśakālāvasthāpekṣiṇaḥ puṇyahetavaḥ kriyāviśeṣāḥ niyamāḥ
devārcanapradakṣiṇāsaṃdhyopāsanajapādayaḥ | yogakarmavirodhikleśajayārthacaraṇa-
bandha āsanaṃ padmakasvastikādi | koṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ gaticchedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ

atha mataṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyudikkālākāśātmanaḥśabdatamāṃsītyekā-
daśaiva padārthāḥ | tadāśritaguṇakarmasāmānyādīnāṃ kathaṃcid bhedābhedasad-
bhāvena tādātmyasaṃbhavānna padārthāntaratvamityevaṃ padārthayāthātmyajñānāt
karmakṣayo bhavatīti bhāṭṭāḥ pratyapīpadan |
te'pyatattvajñā eva | kutaḥ pṛthivyādinavapadārthānāṃ taduktaprakāreṇa
yāthātmyapratipatterasaṃbhavasya vaiśeṣikapadārthavicāre pratipāditatvāt | śabda-
dravyasya nityatvasarvagatatvābhāvatvamapi vedasyāpauruṣeyatvavicāre prati-
pāditamiti neha pratanyate | kevalaṃ tamodravyameva taduktaprakāreṇāsmābhi-
rapyaṅgīkriyate |
nanu prakāśābhāvavyatirekeṇāparasya tamodravyasyābhāvāt tat kathaṃ
yuṣmābhirapyaṅgīkriyate | tathā hi | bhā'bhāvastamaḥ ālokanirapekṣatayā
cākṣuṣatvāt pradīpapradhvaṃsavat iti naiyāyikādayaḥ pratyaprākṣuḥ | te'pi na
vastusvarūpajñāḥ | taduktahetorālokena vyabhicārāt1 | tamodravyasya pramāṇa-
prasiddhatvācca | tathā hi | tamo dharmi dravyaṃ bhavatīti sādhyo dharmaḥ rūpitvāt
paṭādivaditi | nanu tamaso rūpitvamasiddhamiti cenna | tamo rūpī kṛṣṇatve-
nāvabhāsamānatvāt guṇādyanyatve sati2 cākṣuṣatvācca kajjalādivaditi
pramāṇasadbhāvāt | nanu tamasaścākṣuṣatvamasiddhamiti cenna | tamaścākṣuṣaṃ
cakṣurindriyeṇaiva vedyatvāt anyeṣāṃ pratyakṣatve'pi jātyandhasyāpratyakṣatvāt
caṇḍātapavaditi tamasaścākṣuṣatvasiddheḥ | tathā tamo dharmi dravyaṃ bhavatīti
sādhyaṃ śītasparśavattvāt jalādivaditi ca | nanu tamasaḥ śītasparśavattva-
mapyasiddhamiti cenna | tamaḥ śītasparśavat udriktapittapraśāmakatvāt
candanādivaditi pramāṇasadbhāvāt | nanu tamasaḥ udriktapittapraśāmakatvama-
siddhamiti cenna | pittodriktānāmandhakārāvasthāne pittapraśāntidarśanāt
vaidyaśāstre'pi tathā pratipādanācca | iti tamaso dravyatvaṃ seṣidhyate | tathā
chāyāyā api dravyatvaṃ bobhūyata eva kutaḥ tasyā api tamobhedatvādukta-
prakāreṇaiva tatrāpi rūpitvasparśavattvasya samarthayituṃ śakyatvāt | tato na
bhābhāvastamaḥ bhāsā sahāvasthitatvāt paṭādivat | nāyamasiddho hetuḥ
ālokasya ālokanirapekṣatayā cākṣuṣatvepi bhā'bhāvā'bhāvaḥ |
guṇādīnāṃ
cākṣuṣatve'pi rūpitvābhāvaḥ ata uktaṃ guṇānyatve satīti |
mandaprakāśena saha tamaso darśanāt | tasmād bhāṭṭapakṣe'pi tattvayāthātmya-
jñānābhāvāt puruṣāṇāṃ svargāpavargaprāptirapi nāstīti niścīyate | [78. prābhākaramate śaktisvarūpasamarthanam |]
atha matam,
dravyaṃ guṇaḥ kriyā jātiḥ saṃkhyāsādṛśyaśaktayaḥ |
samavāyaḥ kramaśceti nava syurgurudarśane1 ||
tatra dravyaṃ pṛthvyādi | guṇo rūpādiḥ | kriyā utkṣepaṇādiḥ | jātiḥ sattā-
dravyatvādiḥ | saṃkhyā ekadvitryādiḥ | sādṛśyaṃ gopratiyogikaṃ gavayagatamanyat |
gavayapratiyogikaṃ gogataṃ sādṛśyamanyat | śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ śakyānumeyā2 |
guṇaguṇyādīnāṃ saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaḥ | ekasya niṣpādanānantaramanyasya
niṣpādanaṃ kramaḥ prathamāhutyādipūrṇāhutiparyantaḥ | ityevaṃ navaiva padārthāḥ |
eteṣāṃ yāthātmyajñānāt niḥśreyasasiddhiriti prābhākarāḥ pratyācakṣate |
prabhākarasya |
śakyāduttarakāryādanumeyā |
te'pyanabhijñā eva | taduktaprakāreṇāpi padārthānāṃ yāthātmyā ghaṭanāt |
kutaḥ dravyaguṇakriyājātisaṃkhyānāṃ vaiśeṣikoktaprakārāsaṃbhavaprati pādanenaiva
prābhākaroktaprakārāsaṃbhavasyāpi pratipāditatvāt | sādṛśyasyāpi sāmānya-
tvenaiva samarthitatvāt2 na pṛthak padārthāntaratvam | kiṃ ca | sādṛśyapadārthā-
ntaratve vaisādṛśyasyāpi vyāvartakasya padārthāntaratvaṃ syādityatiprasajyate |
tathā samavāyasya prabhākaroktasyāpi prāgeva niṣiddhatvāt na padārthāntaratvam
tathā kramasya padārthāntaratve yaugapadyasyāpi padārthāntaratvaṃ syādityati-
prasajyate | kevalaṃ śaktireva padārthāntaratvena vyavatiṣṭhate |
śaktiḥ sāmarthyaṃ vivakṣitakāryajananayogyatā | sā ca śakyād
vivākṣitāduttarakāryādanumīyate | nanu padārthānāṃ svarūpātiriktaśakterabhāvāt
svarūpamātrādeva vivakṣitottarakāryotpattirbhavati | svarūpasya pratyakṣa-
siddhatvāt na kāryānumeyatvamapīti cenna | mudgamāṣarājamāṣaniṣpāvāḍhaka-
caṇakādīnāṃ svarūpasya pratyakṣataḥ pratipannatve'pi pākyāpākyaśaktiviśeṣa-
sadṛśapariṇāmastiryag khaṇḍamuṇḍādigotvavat | atra gotvaṃ sarvatra sāmānyam
ataḥ sādṛśyasya sāmānyatvam |
syāpratipannatvāt1 | apūrvapuruṣasvarūpasya pratyakṣato niścaye'pi ayametadvi-
dyopādāne samarthaḥ ayametatkāryakaraṇe samartha iti tatsāmarthyasya niścetu-
maśakyatvāt | nanu ekaikāṃ vidyāmupadiśya tadgrahaṇakauśalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tat-
tadvidyopādāne samarthoyamiti niścīyate tathā ekaikaṃ kāryaṃ kurvīteti
pratipādya tattatkauśalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tattatkāryakaraṇasamartho'yamityapi niścīyata
iti cet tarhi utpannaṃ kāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāraṇabhūtaṃ sāmarthyamanumīyata ityuktaṃ
syāt | tathā ca tadeva sāmarthyaṃ śaktirityucyate | nanu tat sāmarthyamapi
padārthānāṃ svarūpameva tataḥ padārthasvarūpātiriktā śaktirnāstīti cenna |
pratyakṣeṇa tatpadārthasvarūpapratipattau satyāmapi tatsāmarthyapratipattyabhāvāt

kiṃcit svarūpamindriyagrāhyaṃ kiṃcit svarūpamatīndriyagrāhyamiti svarūpa-
dvayamastīti cet tarhi yadevendriyagrāhyaṃ na bhavatyatīndriyakāryajanakasvarūpaṃ

ata eva śaktiḥ kāryānumeyā bhavati |

nityanaimittike kuryāt pratyavāyajihāsayā ||
iti bhāṭṭāḥ pratipedire | nanu pratyavāyaparihārakāmatayā nityanaimittikā-
nuṣṭhānayoḥ pravartanāt tayorapi kāmyānuṣṭhānakukṣau nikṣepāt tatkaraṇamapi
mokṣakāṃkṣiṇā na vidhīyata iti prābhākarāḥ pratyūcire |
te sarve'pyanātmajñā eva | vedavākyānāmasatyatvena taduktānuṣṭhānāt
svargāpavargaprāpterayogāt | kathaṃ vedavākyānāmasatyatvamiti cet kathyate |
daśaratho brahmahatyāparihārārthamaśvamedhatrayaṃ vidhāyāpi nārako babhūveti
‘tarati śokaṃ tarati pāpmānaṃ tarati brahmahatyāṃ yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u
cainamevaṃ veda’ ityādīnāmasatyatvaṃ niścīyate | tathā
sitāsite sarite yatra saṃgate tatrāplutāso divamutpatanti |
ye tatra tanvā visṛjanti dhīrāste janāso amṛtatvaṃ bhajante ||
ityādīnāmasatyatvaniścayo'pi gaṅgāyamunayoḥ saṃgame tyaktaśarīrasyādibhara-
tasya kṛṣṇamṛgatvenotpattiśravaṇād bhavati | atha teṣā1marthavādatvādasatya-
tvamapi syāditi cenna | ‘yasmin deśe noṣṇaṃ na kṣunna glāniḥ puṇyakṛta eva
pretya tatra gacchanti’ ityādīnāmapi arthavādatvena asatyatvaprasaṃgāt | tathā
ca svargāderabhāvāt ‘jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta’ ityādivākyānāma-
satyatvaṃ niścīyate jyotiṣṭomayājinaḥ svargaprāpterabhāvāt | api ca vedasyā-
prāmāṇyamapi prāgeva pramāṇaiḥ pratipāditamityatropāraṃsiṣma |
yadapyanyadavādīt ‘akurvan vihitaṃ karma pratyavāyena lipyate’ iti
tadapyasat | vanaspatimṛgapaśupakṣiśūdrādiśvapacāntānāṃ vedoktanityanaimi-
ttikādyanuṣṭhānākaraṇe'pi pratyavāyavilepābhāvāt | nanu tān prati nitya-
naimittikādyanuṣṭhānavidhānābhāvāt teṣāmakaraṇe'pi na pratyavāyavilepaḥ |
api tu traivarṇikānuddiśya vihitatvādakaraṇe teṣāmeva pratyavāyavilepa iti
cet tarhi traivarṇikānāṃ tadakaraṇe pratyavāyena durgatiprāptiḥ tatkaraṇe na
daśarathabharatādivarṇanāyuktānāṃ vedavākyānām |
kiṃcit phalamastīti traivarṇikatvaṃ mahāpāpasya phalaṃ syāt | nanu tatkaraṇe
na kiṃciditi na vaktavyaṃ nityāpūrvalakṣaṇasyādṛṣṭasyotpattikathanāditi cet
tarhi nityāpūrvāt kiṃ phalaṃ bhavati | na kiṃcit phalamiti cet tarhi tadeva
tatkaraṇe na kiṃcit phalamityucyate | yadapyavocat gṛhastho'pi vimucyata
iti tadapyasaṃgatam |
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ1 |
iti caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ nirūpaṇasya vaiyarthyaprasaṃgāt | ‘yadahareva virajet
tadahareva pravrajet’ ityādivākyānāmasatyatvaprasaṃgācca | kutaḥ gṛhasthasyāpi
mokṣasaṃbhave pravrajyāyāḥ niṣphalatvāt |
yadapi prābhākaraḥ pratyacūcudat--nityanaimittikānuṣṭhānamapi mokṣa-
kāṃkṣiṇā na vidhīyata iti-tadapyasaṃgatam | sarvānuṣṭhānābhāve'pi mokṣasaṃbhave
vanaspatyādīnāmapi mokṣaprāptiprasaṃgāt | atha teṣāṃ tattvajñānābhāvānna mokṣa-
prāptiriti cet tarhi jainamatātiriktānāmapi tattvajñānābhāvāt mokṣaprāptirna
syāt | tat kathamiti cet parairnirūpitaprakāreṇa padārthānāṃ yāthātmyā-
chātratvena sthitvā ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyantaṃ paṭhati sa brahmacārī tato gṛhaṃ gatvā pariṇītaḥ
sa gṛhasthaḥ tataḥ sarvaṃ varjayitvā ekāṃ strīṃ gṛhītvā vane sthitaḥ sa vānaprasthaḥ paścāt strīrahito
bhikṣuḥ |
saṃbhavasya prāgeva pramāṇaiḥ pratipāditatvāt | tasmānmīmāṃsakamate mokṣo
nāstīti niścīyate | [80. sāṃkhyasaṃmatā sṛṣṭiprakriyā |]
atha matam1
sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamavaṣṭambhakaṃ calaṃ ca rajaḥ |
guru varaṇakameva tamaḥ sāmyāvasthā bhavet prakṛtiḥ || [sāṃkhyakārikā 13]
tatra yadiṣṭaṃ prakāśakaṃ laghu tat sattvamucyate | sattvodayāt praśastā eva
pariṇāmā jāyante | yacca calamavaṣṭambhakaṃ dhārakaṃ grāhakaṃ vā tad raja iti
kathyate | rajasa udayād rāgapariṇāmā eva jāyante | yad guru āvaraṇakama-
jñānahetubhūtaṃ tat tama iti nirūpyate | tamasa udayād dveṣājñānapariṇāmā
eva jāyante | sattvarajastamasāṃ trayāṇāṃ sāmyāvasthā prakṛtirbhavet |
prakṛtermahāṃstato'haṃkārastasmād gaṇaśca ṣoḍaśakaḥ |
tasmādapi ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni || [sāṃkhyakārikā 22]
nirīśvarasāṃkhyasya |
jagadutpādikā prakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ bahudhānakamiti prakṛterabhidhānāni ca | tataḥ
prakṛtermahānutpadyate | āsargapralayasthāyinī1 buddhirmahān | tato mahataḥ sa-
kāśādahaṃkāra utpadyate ahaṃ jñātā ahaṃ sukhī ahaṃ duḥkhī ityādipratyaya-
viṣayaḥ2 | tato'haṃkārāt gandharasarūpasparśaśabdāḥ pañca tanmātrāḥ sparśanara-
sanaghrāṇacakṣuḥśrotrāṇi pañca buddhīndriyāṇi vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni pañca
karmendriyāṇi manaśceti ṣoḍaśagaṇāḥ samutpadyante | teṣu ṣoḍaśagaṇeṣu pañca-
tanmātrebhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni samutpadyante | tad yathā | gandharasarūpasparśebhyaḥ
pṛthvī, rasarūpasparśebhyo jalaṃ, rūpasparśābhyāṃ tejaḥ, sparśād vāyuḥ,
śabdādākāśaṃ samutpadyate iti sṛṣṭikramaḥ | etāni caturviśatitattvāni |
pañcaviṃśako jīvaḥ iti nirīśvarasāṃkhyāḥ | ṣaḍviṃśako maheśvaraḥ sapta-
viṃśakaḥ paramamukta iti seśvarasāṃkhyāḥ | teṣu tattveṣu
ājanmapralayaḥ janmamaraṇaparyaṃtam |
pratyayo viṣayo yasyāhaṃkārasya saḥ |
mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtirmahadādyāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayaḥ sapta1 |
ṣoḍaśakaśca2 vikāro na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ || (sāṃkhyakārikā 3)
iti sāṃkhyāḥ samyak pratyapīpadan | [81. mahadādyutpattiniṣedhaḥ |]
atra pratividhīyate | yat tāvaduktaṃ prakṛtermahānutpadyata iti prakṛti-
rūpādānatvena buddhimutpādayati sahakārinimittakāraṇatvena vā | na tāva-
dādyaḥ pakṣaḥ cetanāyā buddheracetanopādānakāraṇakatvānupapatteḥ | tathā hi |
buddhirnācetanopādānā cetanatvādanubhavavat | nanu buddheścetanatvamasiddhamiti
cenna | buddhiścetanā svasaṃvedyatvāt ātmavaditi buddheścetanatvasiddheḥ | nanu
buddheḥ svasaṃvedyatvābhāvādayamapyasiddho heturiti cenna | buddhiḥ svasaṃvedyā
svapratibaddhavyavahāre saṃśayādivyavacchedāya sajātīyaparānapekṣatvāt ātma-
vaditi buddheḥ svasaṃvedyatvasiddheḥ | atha ayamapyasiddho heturiti cenna |
buddhiḥ svapratibaddhavyavahāre saṃśayādivyavacchedāya sajātīyaparānapekṣā
mahānahaṃkāraḥ gandharasarūpasparśaśabdāḥ iti pañcatanmātrāḥ iti sapta |
spaśanarasa-
naghrāṇacakṣuḥśrotrāṇi vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthāni paścatanmātrebhyaḥ jātāḥ pṛthivyaptejo-
vāyvākāśāḥ pañca iti ṣoḍaśa |
arthaprakāśakatvāt indriyasaṃprayogamantareṇa pratyakṣatvāt pradīpavaditi tat-
siddheḥ | tasmāt prakṛtirupādānatvena buddhiṃ na janayatītyaṅgīkartavyam |
nāpi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | sāṃkhyaiḥ prakṛteḥ sahakarinimittakāraṇatvānaṅgī-
kārāt | tataśca prakṛtermahānutpadyata iti yat kiṃcidetat |
tathā mahataḥ sakāśādahaṃkāra utpadyata ityatrāpi | mahato buddhe-
rātmadharmatvena upādānatvāyogāt1 | tathā hi | buddhirupādānakāraṇaṃ2 na
bhavati ātmadharmatvāt anubhavavaditi | nanu buddheḥ prakṛtipariṇāmatvādātma-
dharmatvamasiddhamiti cenna | buddhirātmadharmaḥ svasaṃvedyatvāt anubhavavaditi
buddherātmadharmatvasiddheḥ | svasaṃvedyatvaṃ ca tasyāḥ prāgeva samarthitamityu-
paramyate | tathāhaṃkāro'pi ahamiti śabdoccāraṇam, ahaṃpratyayo vā, ahaṃ-
pratyayavedyo'rtho vā syāt | na tāvadādyaḥ, śabdoccāraṇasya pudgalopādāna-
kāraṇāt tālvādinimittakāraṇāt deśakālādisahakārikāraṇādutpadya-
mānatvena mahadupādānakāraṇakatvābhāvāt | nāpi dvitīyaḥ ahaṃpratyaya-
ahaṃkāraṃ prati |
ahaṃkārakāryasya |
syātmopādānakāraṇakatvena mahadupādānakāraṇakatvābhāvāt | tathā hi |
ahaṃpratyayaḥ na mahadupādānakāraṇakaḥ ātmopādānakāraṇakatvāt anubhavavat |
nanu ahaṃpratyayasyātmopādānakāraṇakatvamasiddhamiti cenna | ahaṃpratyayaḥ
ātmopādānakāraṇakaḥ svasaṃvedyatvāt anubhavavaditi tat siddheḥ | nāpi
tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ ahaṃpratyayavedyārthasya ātmatvena mahataḥ sakāśādutpattyayogāt |
nanu ahaṃpratyayavedyo'rtho ahaṃkāra eva na tvātmeti cenna | ahaṃ jñātā ahaṃ
sukhī ahaṃ duḥkhī ahamicchādveṣaprayatnavānityahaṃkārasyaiva jñānādiviśiṣṭa-
tayā pratītyaṅgīkāre aparātmaparikalpanāvaiyarthyaprasaṃgāt1 | etadvyati-
rekeṇāparātmaparikalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvācca | atha parārthyaṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ
saṃghātācca śayanādivaditi2 pramāṇamastīti cenna | siddhasādhyatvena
hetorakiṃcitkaratvāt | kutaḥ cakṣurādīnāṃ jñānādiviśiṣṭārthatvenāsmā-
bhirapyaṅgīkaraṇat3 | tasmānmahataḥ sakāśādahaṃkāraḥ samutpadyata iti yat
kiṃcit |
tathā tasmādahaṃkārāt ṣoḍaśagaṇānāmutpattirityapyasaṃbhāvyameva |
tarhi evaṃbhūto'haṃkāra eva bhavatu aparātmaparikalpanayā kim |
samastavastu-
parāthya iti ātmārthaṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ saṃghātāt mīlanāt | ātmā paro'rthaḥ ahaṃkārabhinna-
tvāt | yathā cakṣurādeḥ saṃdhā??t śayanādau sukhaṃ bhavati tathā pārārthyam | vastusakāśāt
ātmanaḥ sukham |
nidrādiśayyādi ātmanaḥ bhavati na tvahaṃkārasya |
ahaṃkārasyāhaṃpratyayavedyārthasyāhaṃpratyayasya vā svasaṃvedyatvena cetanatvāt
tadupādānatvena pudgalavikārāṇāṃ ṣoḍaśagaṇānāmutpatterasaṃbhavāt | nanu-
ṣoḍaśagaṇānāṃ paudgalikatvaṃ kathamiti cet buddhīndriyakarmendriyamanasāṃ
śarīrāvayavatvasamarthanena prāgeva paudgalikatvasamarthanāt | gandharasarūpa-
sparśaśabdānāṃ pṛthvyādipudgaladharmatvenāpi prāgeva samarthitatvācca |
yadapyanyadavocat pañcatanmātrebhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni samutpadyanta iti tadapya-
sāram | ākāśasya nityatvena śabdādutpattyasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | nitya-
mākāśaṃ sarvagatatvāt ātmavaditi | nanu ākāśasya kāryatvena sarvagata-
tvamasiddhamiti cenna | ākāśaṃ sarvagataṃ sakalamūrtimaddravyasaṃyogitvāt
ātmavaditi tatsiddheḥ | tathā ākāśaṃ nityam amūrtadravyatvāt ātma-
vaditi ca | nanu ākāśasya amūrtatvamasiddhamiti cenna | ākāśamamūrtaṃ
sparśādirahitatvāt ātmavaditi tatsiddheḥ | nanu ākāśasya sparśādi-
rahitatvamasiddhamiti cenna | ākāśaṃ sparśādirahitaṃ mahattve'pi bāhyendriyā-
grāhyatvāt ātmavaditi tatsiddheḥ | tathā pṛthivyādīnāṃ madhye bhūbhuvana-
bhūdharadvīpākūpārādīnāṃ nityatvenotpatterabhāvānna kathamapi tanmātrebhyaḥ samu-
tpattiḥ parikalpayituṃ śakyate | kutasteṣāṃ nityatvamiti cet vītaṃ bhūbhuvanā-
dikaṃ nityam asmadādipratyakṣāvedyamahāparimāṇādhāratvāt ātmavaditi
pramāṇāditi brūmaḥ | itareṣāṃ kāryatvenābhyupagatānāmapi dvyaṇukatryaṇukādīnāṃ
paramāṇudvyaṇukādibhirutpattiprasiddhestanmātrādutpattirna saṃbhavatyeva | tathā
hi | vītāḥ padārthāḥ rūpādimatsvāvayavairutpadyante kāryadravyatvāt paṭādi-
vaditi | atha paramāṇūnāṃ tanmātrebhyaḥ samutpattiriti cenna | yat kāryadravyaṃ
tat svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇāvayavairārabdhaṃ yathā paṭaḥ, kāryadravyāṇi ca
vivādāpannāni tasmāt svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇāvayavairārabdhanīti paraṃ-
parayā akāryāṇāmeva paramāṇutvasiddheḥ | tasmāt prakṛtermahānityādi sṛṣṭi-
kramakathanaṃ gaganendīvaramakarandavyāvarṇanamiva bobhūyate | [82. prakṛtisādhakapramāṇavicāraḥ |]
api ca | prakṛteḥ pramāṇaprasiddhatve sati sarvametadupapadyate | na ca sā
kenacit pramāṇena prasidhyati |
medānāṃ parimāṇāt samanvayācchaktitaḥ pravṛtteśca |
kāraṇakāryavibhāgādavibhāgād viśvarūpasya1 || (sāṃkhyakārikā 15)
ityādihetubhirviśvasya kiṃcit2 kāraṇamastītyanumīyate | tacca kāraṇaṃ

kāryaṃ bhavitumarhati samaḥvāyādityādi jñeyam |

kāryasya |
prasādhyate prakṛtitattvaṃ dharmīkṛtya vā | prathamapakṣe siddhasādhyatvena hetūnāma-
kiṃcitkaratvaṃ syāt | kāryatvenābhyupagatānāṃ buddhisukhādīnāmātmopādā-
natvena itarakāryāṇāṃ pudgalopādānatvena prāgeva samarthitatvāt | paramā-
ṇvākāśabhūbhuvanabhūdharadvīpākūpārādīnāṃ tu nityatvasamarthanena kāraṇajanya-
tvābhāvācca | dvitīyapakṣe āśrayāsiddho hetvābhāsaḥ syāt | kathaṃ prakṛti-
tattvasya dharmiṇaḥ pramāṇapratipannatvābhāvāt |
tathā taduktahetūnāmapi1 vicārāsahatvācca na prakṛtitattvasiddhiḥ |
tathā hi | bhedānāṃ parimāṇāditi ko'rthaḥ | stambhakumbhāmbhoruhādibhedāna
parimāṇadarśanādityarthaḥ iti cenna | hetorbhāgāsiddhatvāt | kutaḥ bhūbhuvana-
bhūdharadvīpākūpārākāśaparamāṇvādibhedānāṃ parimāṇadarśanābhāvāt | atha
teṣāmapi bhedānāṃ parimāṇamanumānādāgamād vā niścīyata iti cet tarhi
devadattayajñadattādyātmabhedānāṃ parimāṇasyāpyanumānagamyatve'pi pradhānakā-
raṇapūrvakatvābhāvāt tadbhedānāṃ parimāṇaiḥ hetorvyabhicāraḥ syāt | tataśca
bhedānāṃ parimāṇāditi hetoḥ prakṛtisiddhirna bobhūyate |
bhedānāṃ parimāṇādityādīnām |
nanu samanvayāditi heto1rbhaviṣyatīti cet samanvayādi ti ko'rthaḥ
bhedānāṃ rāgadveṣamohānvitatvaṃ buddhisukhādyanvitatvaṃ ceti cenna | ātmā-
tiriktapadārthānāṃ tadanvayābhāvena2 hetoḥ svarūpāsiddhatvāt | tathā hi |
rāgādibuddhyādayaḥ ātmanyeva vartante ātmadharmatvāt anubhavavat | atha
rāgādibuddhyādīnāmātmadharmatvamasiddhamiti cenna | rāgādibuddhyādaya
ātmadharmā eva svasaṃvedyatvādanubhavavaditi tatsiddheḥ | nanu rāgādibuddhyā-
dīnāṃ svasaṃvedyatvamasiddhamiti cenna | rāgādibuddhyādayaḥ svasaṃvedyāḥ
svapratibaddhavyavahāre saṃśayādivyavacchedāya parānapekṣatvāt anubhavavaditi
tatsiddheḥ | ayamapyasiddha iti cenna | buddhyādayaḥ svapratibaddhavyavahāre
saṃśayādivyavacchedāya parānapekṣāḥ arthaparicchittirūpatvāt vyatireke
paṭādivaditi tatsiddheḥ | atha rāgādīnāmarthaparicchittirūpābhāvāt kathaṃ
tatsiddhiriti cenna | rāgādayaḥ svapratibaddhavyavahāre saṃśayādivyudāsāya
parānnāpekṣante indriyāviṣayatve'pi pratyakṣatvāt vyatireke paṭādivaditi3
tatsiddheḥ | tathā rāgādayaḥ svasaṃvedyāḥ indriyāviṣayatve'pi pratyakṣatvāt
anubhavavaditi ca | tathā ātmānaḥ rāgādibuddhyādyanvitā bhavanti cetana-
prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvam |
rāgadveṣabuddhisukhādyanvayābhāvena |
ye svapratibaddhavyavahāre
saṃśayādivyudāsāya parān apekṣante te indriyāviṣayatve'pi pratyakṣā na bhavanti yathā paṭādiḥ |
tvāt ajaḍatvāt ajanyatvāt svasaṃvedyatvāt vyatireke paṭādivaditi ca |
rāgādibuddhyādayaḥ ātmātiriktapadārtheṣvanvitā na bhavanti cetanatvāt
svasaṃvedyatvāt anubhavavat | tathā ātmātiriktapadārthāḥ na rāgādibuddhyā-
dimantaḥ jaḍatvāt janyatvāt asvasaṃvedyatvāt paṭādivaditi | tasmāt
samanvayāditi hetorapi na prakṛtisiddhiḥ |
nanu śaktitaḥ pravṛtteśceti prakṛtisiddhirbhaviṣyatīti cet śaktitaḥ
