prakṛtitattva meva śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ karma badhnāti, tatphalaṃ sukhaduḥkhādikaṃ puruṣo'-
nubhuṅkta iti | atha tathaivāstviti cenna | akarturapi karmaphalabhoge muktā-
tmanāmapi tatphalabhogaprasaṃgāt | kiṃca | ātmanaḥ karmakartṛtvābhāve tatphala-
bhogo'pi na prasajyate | tathā hi | vītātmānaḥ na karmaphalabhoktāraḥ tada-
kartṛtvāt muktātmavaditi | tasmāt ātmanaḥ karmaphalabhoktṛtvamicchatā
tatkartṛtvaṃ tadbaddhatvaṃ ca aṅgīkartavyam | tathā ca ātmanaḥ saṃsārāvasthā-
yāmaśuddhatvaṃ siddham | tathā sarvagatatvābhāvasyāpi prāk pramāṇaiḥ pratipādi-
tatvādakriyatvābhāvo'pi niścīyate | tasmāt sāṃkhyoktaprakāreṇa jīvatattva-
syāpi yāthātmyāsaṃbhavāt tadviṣayavijñānasya mithyātvena ajñānatvāt
tataḥ sarvadā bandha eva na tato muktiḥ | tathā coktaṃ tenaiva
dharmeṇa gamanamūrdhvaṃ gamanamadhastāt bhavatyadharmeṇa |
jñānena cāpavargo viparyayādiṣyate bandhaḥ || (sāṃkhyakārikā 44)
iti | tasmāt sāṃkhyapakṣo'pi mumukṣūṇāmupekṣaṇīya eva syāt |

lg.l: ākāśaṃ dbau nirodhau1 ca nityaṃ trayamasaṃskṛtam2 |

doc.p:
tathā hi | vidyujjaladharapradīpatanukaraṇabhuvanādīnāṃ vināśasvabhāvatvena
kṣaṇikatvaṃ siddhameva | atha teṣāṃ vināśasvabhāvatvamasiddhamiti cenna |
vītāḥ padārthā vināśasvabhāvāḥ vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvāt yad yad bhāvaṃ
pratyanyānapekṣaṃ tat tat svabhāvaniyataṃ yathā antyakāraṇasāmagrī3 svakārya-
janane | nanu teṣāṃ vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvamasiddhaṃ vātānalādyupaghātena
vināśadarśanāditi cenna | tadasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | tena kriyamāṇo
cittasantānotpattilakṣaṇo nirodhaḥ santānocchittilakṣaṇo vināśaḥ dvitīyo
nirodhaḥ |
saṃskārarahitaṃ |
sthāsakośakuśulāntaraṃ antyasamaye ghaṭakāryasya parāpekṣatvaṃ
nāsti ghaṭakāryasvarūpameva |
vināśaḥ pradīpāderbhinnaḥ abhinno vā | bhinnaścet pradīpādernityatvaṃ syāt |
svasmād bhinnasya vināśasya tadavasthatvāt | abhinnasya karaṇe1 pradīpādi-
reva kṛtaḥ syāt | tasya pūrvameva siddhatvād vātādyupaghātena karaṇaṃ vyarthameva
syāt | tasmāt pradīpādipadārthānāṃ vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvasiddhiḥ |
vināśasvabhāvatvasiddhiḥ tataśca vivādādhyāsitānāṃ kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti
vaibhāṣikaḥ2 |
nanu tathā dṛṣṭāntāvaṣṭambhena vyomādīnāmapi kṣaṇikatvaṃ setsyati |
tathā hi | yat sat tat kṣaṇikaṃ yathā pradīpaḥ, santaścāmī vyomādaya
iti3 | atha nirodhānāṃ sattvābhāvād bhāgāsiddho hetvābhāsa iti cenna |
teṣāmapyarthakriyākāritvena sattvasaṃbhavāt | tathā coktam
yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasat |
anyat saṃvṛti4 sat prokte te svasāmānyalakṣaṇe || [uddhṛta-nyāyakumudacandra pṛ. 382]
pradīpāderabhinnasya vināśasya karaṇe |
bauddhabhedaḥ |
vyomādayaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ
sattvāt |
kalpanā |
iti sautrāntikaḥ pratyavocat | tāvubhāvapyamāṇikau syātām | tathā hi |

yadapyavādīd vaibhāṣikaḥ padārthānāṃ vināśasvabhāvasamarthanārthaṃ-votāḥ
padārthāḥ vināśasvabhāvāḥ vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvāt, yad yad bhāvaṃ
pratyanyānapekṣaṃ tat tat svabhāvaniyataṃ, yathā antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakārya-
janane iti-tadapyasamañjasam | vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣitvāditi hetora-
siddhatvāt | kutaḥ | vātādyupaghātena pradīpādervinaṣṭatvadarśanāt | evaṃ ca
tena kriyamāṇo vināśaḥ pradīpāderbhinnaḥ abhinno vā kriyata ityādyayuktam |
pradīpāderbhinnasyābhinnasya vā vināśasyānaṅgīkārāt | kutaḥ | vātādyupa-
ghātena pradīpādiḥ svayameva vinaṣṭo lupta ityuktatvāt | svatovināśapakṣe'pi
bhinnābhinnavikalpayoḥ samānatvena svavyāghātitvācca | kiṃ ca | bhāvānāṃ
vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣitvaniyame saugatānāmavidyātṛṣṇāvināśalakṣaṇo1
mokṣaḥ santānocchittilakṣaṇo2 vā mokṣo nāṣṭāṅgahetuko3 bhavet | dṛṣṭāntasya
sādhyasādhanobhayavikalatvaṃ ca | kutaḥ antyakāraṇasāmagtyāṃ svakārya-
jīvanmuktiḥ |
paramamuktiḥ |
aṣṭāṅgāni samyaktvaṃ saṃjñā saṃjñī vākkāyaka-
rmāntarvyāyāmājīvasthitisamādhilakṣaṇāni | uttareṇa vyākhyānaṃ kariṣyati |
jananasvabhāvatvaṃ svakāryajananaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvamevobhayavādisaṃpratipannatvena
vivakṣitam, na tu vināśasvabhāvatvaṃ vināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvaṃ vā | tatra1
dvayorvipratipattisadbhāvāt | tasmād bhāvānāṃ vināśasvabhāvatvāsiddherna
kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ vaibhāṣikasya |

yadapi kṣaṇikatvasamarthanārthaṃ sautrāntikaḥ pratyapīpadat-yat sat tat
kṣaṇikaṃ2 yathā pradīpādiḥ santaścāmī vyomādaya iti tadayuktam | hetoḥ
svarūpāsiddhatvāt | kutaḥ kṣaṇikapadārtheṣu sattvasyānupapatteḥ tat kathamiti
cet yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasaditi svayamevābhidhānāt |
kṣaṇikeṣu kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | kṣaṇi-
kasya tāvat krameṇārthakriyākāritvaṃ nopapanīpadyate | deśakālakramayostatrā-
saṃbhavāt | kutaḥ
yo yatraiva sa tatraiva yo yadaiva tadaiva saḥ |
na deśakālayorvyāptirbhāvānāmiha vidyate ||
iti svayamevābhidhānāt | tathā kṣaṇikasya yaugapadyenāpi arthakriyā na
jāghaṭīti | ekasmin samaye uttarottarānantasamayeṣu kriyamāṇārthakriyāṇāṃ
vināśa-svabhāvatvavināśaṃ pratyanyānapekṣatvayoḥ |
padārthāḥ sarve kṣaṇikāḥ sattvāt |
kartumaśakyatvāt | śakyatve vā dvitīyādisamayeṣu arthakriyābhāvenāsattva-
prasaṃgācca | tasyāsattve tatpūrvakṣaṇikasyāpyarthakriyābhāvenāsattvaṃ tasyāsattve
tatpūrvakṣaṇikasyāpyevamasattvamiti sarvaśūnyatāpātāt kṣaṇikatvaṃ kauta-
skutam | nanu ekasmin samaye katipayārthakriyāḥ karoti1 anantarasamaye
aparārthakriyāḥ karoti tadanantarasamaye'pyaparārthakriyāḥ karoti tenaivaṃ
padārthakriyākāritvamiti cenna | evaṃ satyakṣaṇikatvaprasaṃgāt2 yo yadaiva
tadaiva sa ityāgamabādhitatvācca |

kiṃ ca | kṣaṇikaṃ vastu svotpattisamaye kāryaṃ janayatyanantarasamaye
vā | na dvitīyaḥ, svotpattisamaya ekaḥ kāryajananasamaya eka iti kṣaṇadvayā-
vasthāyitvenākṣaṇikatvaprasaṃgāt | nāpi prathamaḥ | svotpattisamaye kārya-
janakatve tat kāraṇasyāpi svotpattisamaye svakāryajanakatvaṃ tat kāraṇa-
syāpi svotpattisamaye svakāryajanakatvamiti sakalakāryāṇāmanādita eva
kṣaṇikaṃ kartṛbhūtam |
kṣaṇikaṃ kartṛbhūtam ekasmin samaye katipayapadārthakriyāḥ
karoti anantarasamaye tadeva kṣaṇikaṃ katipayapadārthaktriyāḥ karoti iti akṣaṇikaṃ tāvat kālaṃ
sthitiṃ karoti ataḥ |
ekasmin samaye samutpattiprasaṃgāt | tathā ca tadanantarasakalasamayeṣu artha-
kriyāśūnyatvenāsatvaprasaṃgāt | tasmāt kṣaṇikapadārthe kramayaugapadyābhyāmartha-
kriyākāritvāsaṃbhavena sattvāsaṃbhavāt hetoḥ1 svarūpāsiddhatvaṃ samarthitam |

tasmād dīpādayo vītāḥ padārthā akṣaṇikāḥ sa evāhaṃ sa evāya-
miti pratyabhijñāviṣayatvāt | yaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ sa pratyabhijñāviṣayo na bhavati
yathā pradīpaśikhānirgato dhūmaḥ, tathā cāyaṃ tasmāt tatheti2 pratipakṣasiddheḥ |
nanu pratyabhijñānasya prāmāṇyābhāvāt na tato'kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti cenna |
vītaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ pramāṇameva abādhitaviṣayatvāt nirduṣṭapratyakṣavaditi tasya
prāmāṇyasiddheḥ | atha pratyabhijñānasyābādhitaviṣayatvamasiddhamiti cenna |
tadviṣayasya bādhakāsaṃbhavāt | na tāvat savikalpakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhakaṃ tasya
sthirārthagrāhakatvena sādhakatvāt | nāpi nirvikalpakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhakaṃ
tasyaivābhāvāt | bhāve vā3 tasya sthirārthavārtānabhijñatvena bādhakatvānu-
sattvāt iti hetoḥ |
ayaṃ padārthaḥ pratyabhijñānaviṣayaḥ tasmāt tatheti
akṣaṇikaḥ |
nirvikalpakasya bhāve |
papatteḥ | nāpyanumānaṃ bādhakaṃ kṣaṇikatvaprasādhakānumānānāṃ prāgeva nirākṛta-
tvāt | nāgamo'pi bādhakaḥ | ubhayābhimatatathāvidhāgamābhāvāt1 | saugata-
mate pratyakṣānumānābhyāmanyapramāṇābhāvācca | tasmāt prakṛtapratyabhijñānasya
bādhakābhāvāt prāmāṇyasiddhestato vimatānāmātmādipadārthānāmakṣaṇika-
tvasiddhirbhavedeva |

tathā ātmano'kṣaṇikāḥ dattanikṣepādigrāhakatvāt vyatireke pradīpa-
śikhānirgatadhūmavat | yadi kṣaṇikatvaṃ na dāturnikṣepakasya vā tadānīṃ
vinaṣṭatve tatpadārthaṃ smṛtvā punaranugṛhṇīyāt | nanu saṃskārasadbhāvāt
tadvaśena grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | tasyāpi kṣaṇikatvena tadānīṃ vinaṣṭa-
tvāt | atha uttarottarasaṃskārotpatteḥ sadbhāvāt tadvaśena punastadgrahaṇaṃ
bhaviṣyatīti cenna | teṣāṃ tadvastuvārtānabhijñatvāt | tathā dattanikṣipta-
padārthāḥ akṣaṇikāḥ smṛtvā punargrāhyatvāt vyatireke capalādivaditi ca |

tathā ātmanaḥ akṣaṇikāḥ bhūyo darśanāt gṛhītavyāpteḥ smārakatvāt
bauddhamate āgamābhāvaḥ jainamate pratyabhijñābādhako na |
vyatireke capalādivat | teṣāṃ kṣaṇikatvena tadānīṃ vināśe anvayavyati-
rekayorbhūyo darśanāt sādhyasādhanayorvyāptigrahaṇaṃ nopapadyate | vyāpti-
grahaṇe'pi gṛhītavyāptikasya tadānīṃ vinaṣṭatvāt tatsmaraṇaṃ na jāghaṭyate
tatsmṛtāvapi smārakasya tadānīṃ vinaṣṭatvāt tadanumānaṃ na jāghaṭīti |
anumitāvapi anumātustadānīṃ vinaṣṭatvādiṣṭāniṣṭasādhanatvaṃ jñātvā tatra
pravṛttinivṛttivyavahārapravartakatvaṃ nopapanīpadyate | nanu ātmanaḥ kṣaṇikatve'pi
saṃskārasadbhāvāt tadvaśena bhūyodarśanādikaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | saṃskāra-
syāpi kṣaṇikatvena tadānīṃ vinaṣṭatvāt | nanu sadṛśāparāparasaṃskāro-
tpatterbhūyodarśanādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna | uttarottarotpannasaṃskārāṇāṃ
prāktanatadvārtānabhijñātatvāt | tatkathamiti cet prapitāmahena bhūyodarśanaṃ
pitāmahena vyāptigrahaṇaṃ pitrā vyāptismaraṇaṃ putreṇānumānaṃ pautreṇeṣṭasādhana-
jñānaṃ prapautreṇa tatra pravartanamityādivat citkṣaṇānāṃ saṃskārakṣaṇānāmapya-
nyonyapramitārthāparijñānāt kathaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhūyodarśanādikamekānusaṃdhāna-
gocaratvena jāghaṭyate | tasmādātmāno'kṣaṇikāḥ bhūyodarśanād vyāpti-
grahaṇasmaraṇānumānapravartanādiṣvanusaṃdhātṛtvāt vyatireke1 capalādiva-
dityātmādīnāmakṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ |

atha matam-rūpavedanāvijñānasaṃjñāsaṃskārā iti pañca skandhāḥ
saṃcitālambanāḥ pañcavijñānakāyāḥ pañcendriyajñānāni | tatra rūparasagandha-
sparśaparamāṇavaḥ sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttāḥ parasparamasaṃbaddhāḥ rūpa-
skandhāḥ teṣāmasaṃbaddhatvaṃ kuta iti cet
ekadeśena saṃbandhe paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍaṃśatā |
sarvātmanābhisaṃbandhe piṇḍaḥ syādaṇumātrakaḥ ||
iti vacanāt | ata evāvayavidravyamapi na jāghaṭyate | tathā hi | yadagrahe
ye akṣaṇikā na bhavanti te bhūyodarśanād vyāptigrahaṇasmaraṇānumānapravartanādi-
ṣvanusaṃdhātāro na bhavanti |
yanna gṛhyate tat tato nārthāntaram, yathā vṛkṣāgrahe agṛhyamāṇaṃ vanam1, na
gṛhyate ca tantvagrahe paṭaḥ tasmāt tato nārthāntaramiti2 | tathā yad dṛśyaṃ
sannopalabhyate3 tannāstyeva yathā kharaviṣāṇam | dṛśyaḥ sannopalabhyate ca
avayavīti4 ca | tathā sukhaduḥkhādayo vedanāskandhāḥ | savikalpakanirvi-
kalpakajñānāni vijñānaskandhāḥ |
jātikriyāguṇadravyasaṃjñāḥ pañcaiva kalpanāḥ |
aśvo yāti sito ghaṇṭī kattālākhyo yathā kramāt ||
ityetatkalpanāsahitaṃ savikalpakaṃ tadrahitaṃ nirvikalpakamiti | tathā
vṛkṣādināmāni saṃjñāskandhāḥ | jñānapuṇyapāpavāsanāḥ saṃskāraskandhā iti |

atra pratividhīyate | yat tāvaduktaṃ rūparasagandhasparśaparamāṇavaḥ
sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttāḥ parasparamasaṃbaddhā iti tatra sajātīyavyāvṛttā
ityayuktam | teṣāṃ5 sadātmanā vyāvṛttatve asattvaprasaṃgāt | dravyātmanā
vyāvṛttatve adravyatvaṃ rūpādyātmanā vyāvṛttatve arūpāditvaprasaṃgācca | tasmād
ata eva vṛkṣā eva na vanam avayavi |
tantava eva avayavarūpāḥ na paṭaḥ ava-
yavī vartate |
yat avalokyamānaṃ na dṛśyate tannāsti yathā kharaviṣāṇaṃ |
paṭaghaṭa-
vanādi |
sajātīyānāṃ rūparasādīnāṃ |
vijātīyavyāvṛttā api1 sajātīyavyāvṛttā na bhavanti ityaṅgīkartavyam |
tathā parasparamasaṃbaddhā ityayuktam | jaghanyaguṇaparamāṇūn vihāya anyeṣāṃ
parasparasaṃbandhasaṃbhavāt | kutaḥ saṃbandhayogyasnigdharūkṣaguṇasadbhāvāt2 |
tadapi kuto jñāyate iti cet vītāḥ paramāṇavaḥ snigdharūkṣaguṇavantaḥ pud-
galatvāt navanītāñjanādivaditi pramāṇāditi brūmaḥ | nanu tathāpi
ṣaṭkena3 yugapad yogāt paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍaṃśatā |
ṣaṇṇāṃ samānadeśatve piṇḍaḥ syādaṇumātrakaḥ || (vijñāptimātratāsiddhiḥ 12)
iti dūṣaṇadvayaṃ nāpākrāmatīti cenna | paramāṇūnāṃ parasparamekadeśena
saṃvandheṅgīkriyamāṇe kasyāpi doṣasyāvakāśāsaṃbhavāt | atha ekadeśena
saṃbandhe paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍaṃśatāpattiriti cet ṣaḍaṃśatāpattiriti ko'rthaḥ |
paraṇāmavaḥ |
paraṇāmavaśca paramāṇūnāṃ snigdharūkṣaguṇāśca teṣāṃ sadbhāvāt |
paramāṇūnāṃ ṣaṭkena |
ṣaḍavayavāpattiḥ ṣaḍvibhāgāpattirvā | ṣaḍavayavāpattiścet tadavayavā1 eva
parasparaṃ saṃbaddhaparamāṇava iti teṣāṃ saṃbandhasiddhiḥ | atha teṣāmapyekadeśena
saṃbandhe pratyekaṃ ṣaḍavayavāpattiriti cet tarhi tadavayavā eva paramāṇava iti
teṣāṃ parasparaṃ saṃbaddhatvasiddhiḥ | ityādikrameṇa avayavairanārabdhānāmeva
paramāṇutvaṃ teṣāmekadeśena saṃbandhe'pi na ṣaḍavayavāpattiḥ2 | tato'pi sūkṣmā-
vayavānāmasaṃbhavāt | atha ṣaḍaṃśatāpattiriti ṣaḍvibhāgāpattiriti cenna |
avibhāgiparamāṇorapi pūrvapaścimadakṣiṇottarordhvādhodigbhāgasya virodhā-
bhāvāt | tasmādavayavairanārabdhāvibhāgisūkṣmaparamāṇūnāṃ parasparaṃ saṃbandhe'pi
na kaścid doṣa iti samarthitaṃ bhavati | ṣaṇṇāṃ samānadeśatvaṃ3 nopapadyata
ityasmābhirapyagre niṣetsyata ityatroparamyate |

tathā ca paramāṇūnāṃ parasparasaṃbandhasaṃbhavādavayavi dravyamapi sukhena
jāghaṭyate | tatra yadapyavādīt-yadagrahe yanna gṛhyate tat tato nārthāntaraṃ
yathā vṛkṣāgrahe agṛhyamāṇaṃ vanaṃ na gṛhyate ca tantvagrahe paṭaḥ tasmāt tato
te paramāṇavaḥ ca te avayavāśca tadavayavāḥ |
tarhi kiṃ saṃbaṃdha eva |
ṣaṭsu
dikṣu sthitānāmaṇūnāṃ madhyasthite aṇau adhīnatvaṃ samānadeśatvam |
nāthāntaramiti--tadasat | tatra pakṣe hetuprayoge paṭo dharmī tantubhyo nārthā-
ntaraṃ tantvagrahe agṛhyamāṇatvādityuktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca dharmī pramāṇapratipanno
na vā | prathamapakṣe kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetvābhāsaḥ | kutaḥ pakṣasya dharmi-
grāhakapramāṇabādhitatvāt | dvitīyapakṣe āśrayāsiddho hetvābhāsaḥ | dharmiṇaḥ
pramāṇapratipannatvābhāvāt | dṛṣṭāntasya1 sādhyasādhanobhayavikalatvaṃ ca |
kutaḥ tantubhyo nārthāntaramiti sādhyasya tantvagrahe agṛhyamāṇatvāditi
sādhanasya vā dṛṣṭāntatvenopātte vane asaṃbhavāt | tathā yadapyanyadabhyadhāyi-
yad dṛśyaṃ sannopalabhyate tannāstyeva yathā kharaviṣāṇaṃ dṛśyaḥ sannopalabhyate
ca avayavīti-tatrāpi pakṣe hetuprayoge avayavī dharmī nāstīti sādhyo
dharmaḥ dṛśyatve satyanupalabhyatvādityuktaṃ syāt | tathā ca dharmiṇaḥ pramāṇa-
pratipannatve pakṣasya dharmigrāhakapramāṇabādhitatvāt kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetvā-
bhyāsaḥ syāt | kharaviṣāṇavadityatrāpi atyantābhāvaḥ kharamastakasthaṃ
viṣāṇaṃ vā dṛṣṭāntaḥ | prathamapakṣe sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt | atyantā-
dṛṣṭāṃtatvenopāttaṃ vanam |
bhāvasya sarvadā astitvāt | dvitīyapakṣe āśrayahīno dṛṣṭāntaḥ syāt |
kharamastake viṣāṇasya trikāle'pyasattvāt | tasmānnirbādhapratyakṣagocaratvād
vajramaṇiśilāstambhāyaḥsārapiṇḍapaṭaghaṭādīnāmavayavidravyatvaṃ siddhameva |
tataśca saugatoktarūpaskandhāḥ na jāghaṭyante | tathā vedanāskandhā api |
sukhaduḥkhādīnāmātmaviśeṣaṇaguṇatvena skandhatvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā vijñānā-
nāmapi skandhatvaṃ nopapanīpadyate | teṣāmapi ātmaguṇatvena skandhatvānupa-
patteḥ | teṣāmātmaviśeṣaguṇatvaṃ prāgeva samarthitamiti neha pratanyate |

yaduktam-jātikriyāguṇadravyasaṃjñāḥ pañcaiva kalpanāḥ aśvo yāti sito
ghaṇṭī kattālākhyo yathā kramādityetatkalpanāsahitaṃ savikalpakaṃ tadrahitaṃ
nirvikalpakamiti-tadasamañjasam | kalpanārahitasya jñānasyāsaṃbhavāt |
tathā hi | jaladharādyekavastupratipattāvapi saditi sattājātiḥ pratīyate |
dhāvatīti kriyā pratīyate | kṛṣṇavarṇa iti guṇaḥ pratīyate | vidyutvāniti
dravyaṃ pratīyate | megho'yamiti paribhāṣā pratīyate | iti kalpanārahitasyaiva
jñānasyāsaṃbhavāt | sattādijātirūpādiguṇadeśakālādidravyarahitasya
cākṣuṣādipratyakṣagocaratvāsaṃbhavācca | nanu svasaṃvedanapratyakṣasya kalpanā-
rahitasya svarūpamātragrāhitvāt tasya nirvikalpakatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cenna |
tasyāpi kalpanārahitasya svarūpamātragrāhitvāsaṃbhavāt | tathā hi | idaṃ
nīlaṃ jānāmi jñātamidaṃ nīlamidaṃ pītaṃ jānāmi jñātamidaṃ pītamiti
deśakālādiviśiṣṭanīlapītādiviśeṣyatvena viśeṣaṇatvena vā jñāna-
svarūpasya vedyatvāt | anyathā avedyatvāt | taduktam |
arthe naiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyā1 |
na hi jñānamiti jñānaṃ2 tasmāt sālambanā matiḥ ||
anyatheyamanālambā labhamānodayā kvacit |
hanyādekaprahāreṇa bāhyārthaparikalpanām ||
ityatiprasajyate | nanu evaṃvidho'tiprasaṃgo'ṅgīkriyata iti yogācāramādhyami-
kāvavocatām3 | tāvapyanātmajñau | ātmakhyātinirākaraṇena asatkhyāti-
nirākāratayā dhiyā arthe viśeṣo na hi |
nirākāradhiyā jñānamiti jñānaṃ na
hi |
artho jñānasamanvito matimatā vaibhāṣikeṇādṛtaḥ pratyakṣaṃ na hi bāhya vastuviṣayaṃ
sautrāṃntikeṇādṛtam | yogācāramatānusārimatayaḥ sākārabuddhiṃ pare manyante khalu madhya mā jaḍa-
dhiyaḥ śuddhāṃ ca tāṃ saṃvidam ||
nirākaraṇena ca bāhyārthasya tatra pramāṇaiḥ samarthitatvāt | kiṃ ca | artha-
rahitajñānamātrapratibhāse'pi sattāguṇatvajñānatvajātikalpanā jñānamiti
nāmakalpanā ca pratīyate | tasmāt kalpanārahitaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nopapanīpadyata eva |

nanu
bhavānasau [manaso] yugapadvṛtteḥ savikalpanirvikalpayoḥ |
vimūḍho laghuvṛttervā tayoraikyaṃ vyavasyati || (pramāṇavārtika 2-13)
iti cenna | tasya vicārāsahatvāt | tathā hi | vimūḍhastayoraikyaṃ savi-
kalpakena vyavasyati nirvikalpakena vā niścinuyāt | na tāvat savikalpa-
kena tasya nirvikalpakavārtānabhijñatvāt | nāpi nirvikalpakena tasya
savikalpakavārtānabhijñatvāt | atha ālayavijñānena tayoraikyaṃ niścinotīti
cet tarhi ālayavijñānaṃ nāma kimucyate | nityajñānamiti cet tasya
vastutvamavastutvaṃ vā | vastutve tasyaiva nityacaitanyasya ātmatvāt kṣaṇikaṃ
sarvātmaśūnyamakartṛkamityetat viruddhyeta | tasyāvastutve tena tayoraikya-
niścayāyogāt tasmāt tayoraikyaṃ vyavasyatītyasaṃbhāvyameva | kiṃ ca |
nirvikalpakapratyakṣasadbhāvāvedakapramāṇābhāvāt tannāstīti niścīyate |

nanu
yatraiva janayedenāṃ1 tatraivāsya pramāṇatā |
iti savikalpakabuddhijanakatvena tadastitvaṃ2 niścīyata iti cenna |
tajjanakatvena ātmāntaḥkaraṇena cakṣurādīnāmeva3 niścitatvāt | tasmāt
nirvikalpakapratyakṣāvedakapramāṇābhāvāt tannāstīti niścīyate | tathā
vṛkṣādināmnāṃ skandhatvaṃ jainamate eva nānyatra saṃbhāvyate | tanmate paudga-
likatvena śabdasya samarthitatvāt | tathā saṃskārāṇāmapyātmaguṇatvena
prāgeva samarthitatvāt skandhatvaṃ nopapanīpadyate | evaṃ saugatoktapañcavijñāna-
kāyānāmapi vicārāsahatvāt tanmate'pi tattvajñānābhāvānmokṣo nāstīti
niścīyate |

atha matam-duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgaṇā iti catvāraḥ padārthā eva
mumukṣubhirjñātavyāḥ | tatra sahajaśārīramānasāgantukāni duḥkhāni | tatra
thatraiva vastuni nirvikalpakaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ savikalpabuddhiṃ janayet |
nirvikalpakasyā-
stitvaṃ |
mayi cakṣurvartate rūpānyathānupapatteḥ |
sahajaṃ kṣuttṛṣāmanobhūvādikam | śārīraṃ vātapittapīnasānāṃ vaiṣamyasaṃbhū-
tam | mānasaṃ dhikkārāvajñecchāvighātādijanitam | āgantukaṃ śīta-
vātātapāśanipātādijanitam | etadduḥkhaviśiṣṭāścittakṣaṇāḥ saṃsāriṇo
duḥkhamityucyate | tadduḥkhajananakarmabandhahetubhūte avidyātṛṣṇe sabhudaya-
śabdenocyete | tatra vastuyāthātmyāpratiprattiravidyā | iṣṭāniṣṭendriyaviṣaya-
prāptiparihāravāñchā tṛṣṇā | nirodho nāmāvidyātṛṣṇāvināśena nirāsrava-
cittasaṃtānotpattilakṣaṇaḥ saṃtānocchittilakṣaṇo vā mokṣaḥ | tathā mokṣa-
hetubhūtā mārgaṇā | sā ca samyaktvasaṃjñāsaṃjñivākkāyakarmāntavyāyāmājī-
vasthitisamādhilakṣaṇāṣṭhāṅgā | tatra samyaktvaṃ nāma padārthānāṃ yāthātmya-
darśanam | saṃjñā vācakaḥ śabdaḥ | saṃjñī vācyo'rthaḥ | vākkāyakarmaṇī
vākkāyavyāpārau | antarvyāyāmo vāyudhāraṇā | ājīvasthitirāyura-
vasānaparyantaṃ prāṇadhāraṇā | samādhirnāma sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ sarvaṃ
nirātmakaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyamiti caturāryasatyabhāvanā | tasyāḥ prakarṣādavidyā-
tṛṣṇāvināśe nirāsravacittakṣaṇāḥ sakalapadārthāvabhāsakāḥ samutpadyante
tad yogipratyakṣam | sa ca yogī yāvadāyustāvatkālamupāsakānāṃ dharma-
mupadiśaṃstiṣṭhati | taduktam--
ubhe satye samāśritya buddhānāṃ dharmadeśanā |
lokasaṃvṛtisatyaṃ ca satyaṃ ca paramārthataḥ || (mādhyamikakārikā 24-8)
nirvāṇe'pi pariprāpte dayārdrīkṛtacetasaḥ |
tiṣṭhantyeva parādhīnā yeṣāṃ tu mahatī kṛpā || (pramāṇavārtika 2-199)
iti | āyuravasāne pradīpanirvāṇopamaṃ nirvāṇaṃ bhavati | uttaracittasyo-
tpatterabhāvāt | tadapyuktam--
dīpo yathā nirvṛtimabhyupaiti naivāvaniṃ gacchati nāntarikṣam |
diśaṃ na kāṃcid vidiśaṃ na kāṃcit snehakṣayāt kevalameti śāntim ||
jībastathā nirvṛtimabhyupaiti naivāvaniṃ gacchati nāntarikṣam |
diśaṃ na kāṃcid vidiśaṃ na kāṃcin mohakṣayāt kevalameti śāntim || (saundarananda 16-28, 29)
iti saugataḥ punarapyacūcudat |

tadayuktam | tanmate anuṣṭhāturapavargaprāpterasaṃbhavāt | kutaḥ tasya-
kṣaṇikatvena tadānīmeva vinaṣṭatvāt | yadapyanyadavocat-samyaktvaṃ nāma
padārthānāṃ yāthātmyadarśanamiti-tadasat | taduktaprakāreṇa padārthayāthātmya-
darśanānupapatteḥ prāgeva samarthitatvāt | yadapyanyadavādīt-saṃjñāvācakaḥ
śabda iti-tadapyayuktam | tanmate śabdasyārthavācakatvābhāvāt | nanu
apohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ na vastuvidhinopalabhyata iti vacanāt śabda iti
tadayuktam | tanmate śabdasyārthavācakatvābhāvasyāpohavācakatvamastīti cenna |
sakalaśabdānāmapohavācakatve uttamavṛddhenopadiṣṭaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā madhyama-
vṛddhasya bāhye arthe pravṛttivyavahārānupapatteḥ | kutaḥ śabdaśravaṇādiṣṭāniṣṭa-
vastupratipatterabhāvāt | saṃketānupapattiśca apohasyābhāvarūpatvāviśeṣāt |
asya śabdasyāyamartho vācya iti saṃketayitumupāyābhāvāt | tasmāt
saṃjñā vācakaḥ śabda ityayuktam | tathā saṃjñī vācyo'rtha ityapyayuktam |
kasmāt tathārthasyāvācyatvāt | tathā vākkāyakarmāntarvyāyāmājīvasthi-
tīnāṃ kṣaṇikapakṣe atyantābhāva eva | yadanyadavādīt-samādhirnāma sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ
sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ sarvaṃ nirātmakaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyamiti caturāryasatyabhāvaneti-tadapya-
samañjasam | tasyāḥ mithyātvena satyabhāvanātvānupapatteḥ | kutaḥ sarvasya
kṣaṇikatvanirātmakatvaśūnyatvāsaṃbhavasya prāgeva pramāṇaiḥ samarthitatvāt | tathā
ca bhāvanāprakarṣādavidyātṛṣṇāvināśe nirāsravacittakṣaṇāḥ sakalapadārthāva-
bhāsakāḥ samutpadyanta ityetad vandhyāsutāt sakalacakravartinaḥ samutpadyanta
ityuktimanuharati | yadapyanyadabhyadhāyi-ubhe satye samāśritya buddhānāṃ
dharmadeśanā lokasaṃvṛtisatyaṃ ca satyaṃ ca paramārthata iti--tadapyayuktam |
tadupadeśasya paramārthasatyatvānupapatteḥ | kutaḥ tanmate paramārthabhūtānāṃ
svalakṣaṇānāṃ sakalavāggocarātikrāntatvāt | tathā ca buddhopadeśāt
prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāṃ pravṛttirna jāghaṭyate | yadapyabravīt-āyuravasāne pradīpa-
nirvāṇopamaṃ nirvāṇaṃ bhavati uttaracittasyotpatterabhāvāditi-tadapyasat |
antyacittakṣaṇasyārthakriyāśūnyatvenāsattvaprasaṃgāt | tasyāsattve tatpūrva-
kṣaṇasyāpyarthakriyārahitatvenāsattvam, tata eva tatpūrvakṣaṇānāmapyasattvena
sarvaśūnyatāpattireva syāt | tasmāt prekṣāpūrvakāribhirmumukṣubhirbauddhapakṣa
upekṣaṇīya eva na pakṣīkartavya iti sthitam ||

iti paravādigirisureśvaraśrībhāvasenatraividyadevaracite mokṣaśāstre
viśvatattvaprakāśe aśeṣaparamatatattvavicāreṇa prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ ||

lg.l: mā bauddha pracuraṃ prajalpa kimidaṃ cārvāka te cāpalaṃ
kiṃ vaiśeṣika garvito'si kimidaṃ sāṃkhya pragalbhāyase |
kiṃ mīmāṃsaka mastake na bibhṛṣe sadyaḥ praṇāmāñjaliṃ
kastvaṃ chāndasa padmabhūrahamaho kutra sthitā bhāratī
śeṣā ye prativādinaḥ svasadaneṣveva sthitā mauninaḥ || 2 ||
kavayaḥ ke vādinaḥ ke mṛdumadhuravacovāgminaḥ ke narāṇāṃ
smaraṇajñā ye viśuddhyā praṇamanasahitā ye prapūjānvitā ye
saṃgītaṃ sarvakāvyaṃ sarasakavikṛtaṃ nāṭakaṃ vetsi samyag
ccarisaluveḍele hogu bauddha nijagarvāṭopamaṃ māṇu saṃ-
sārthāpattyā prabhākṛd vadati tadakhilaṃ pañcakaṃ tacca bhaṭṭaḥ

doc.p:
svastiśrī śake || 1536 pravartamāne ānaṃdanāmasaṃvatsare phālguna-
māse kṛṣṇapakṣe paṃcamī guruvāre || śrījayaturanagare śrīmahāvīrajinatribhuvana-
tilakacaityālaye | śrīmūlasaṃghe sarasvatīgacche balātkāragaṇe śrīkuṃdakuṃdā-
cāryānvaye || bhaº śrīdeveṃdrakīrtidevāstatpaṭṭe bhaº śrīdharmacaṃdradevāstatpaṭṭe
bhaº śrīdharmabhūṣaṇadevāstatpaṭṭe bhaº śrīdeveṃdrakīrtidevāstatpaṭṭe malayakheḍa-
siṃhāsanādhīśvarabhaṭṭārakavareṇya bhaº śrīkumudacadroṃpadeśāt | śrīvaghera-
vālajñātīyaścāmarāgotre || saṃśrī sonāsā bhāryā saṃº caṃdāi tayoḥ putraḥ
trayaḥ || saṃº śrīsājana bhāº hīrāi dvitīya bhrāº śrīṛṣabhadāsa bhā0
rūpāi tṛtiya bhrāta saṃº śrīhīrāsā bhāº pūtalāi tayoḥ putraḥ | sāśrīpadmaṇa
tasya bhāº gavarāi dvitīyaḥ sā śrīpāmā bhāº caṃdāi | sā śrīdemājī |
sā śrīvardhamāna | sā śrīrājabā | sā śrījasabā || eteṣāṃ madhye saṃº śrī-
hīrāsā nijakevalajñānaprāptyarthaṃ || iyaṃ viśvatattvaprakāśikā bhaº śrīkumuda-
caṃdraśiṣya braº śrīvīradāsādāyi || maṃgalaṃ bhūyāt || śreyo bhūyāt ||
śrīrastu lekhakapāṭhakayoḥ ||

lg.l: tannaumi kumudeṃdukaṃ hyaghaharaṃ yasmāt pragalbhā varā

doc.lg:
vīradāsanarakupramadotkaraṃ muktipaṃthabharadarśinamīśvaraṃ |
caṃdrabhaṃ sakaladravyanayoddhuraṃ yajñakṛnmatiratiṃ hyavanaumyaram || kelikābadhoṃyam
